jobs.title: Engineering Manager
jobs.description: **About the Company** --------------------- Valon is building the AI\-native operating system for regulated finance, starting with mortgage servicing. We're a Series C company backed by a16z, transforming industries that others have written off as too complex to innovate. Rather than build on top of broken legacy systems, we took a different approach: we built and operate our own mortgage servicing business managing $110\+ billion in loans. This wasn't the end goal, it was how we deeply understood the complexity needed to build software that actually works in regulated industries. The results speak for themselves. We've transformed mortgage servicing from a 0% margin business into 60%\+ margins while dramatically improving customer experience. Major enterprise contracts are now deploying across the industry. ValonOS is our unified platform that makes every process structured and programmable and it is perfectly positioned for the AI era. When everything flows through one system with rich data, AI agents don't just automate tasks, they continuously improve entire operations. Mortgage servicing is just the beginning of our vision to transform regulated industries and beyond. **Engineering at Valon** ------------------------ Our engineering team is here to power the software ecosystem to disrupt one of the most outdated and regulated spaces in the financial sector \- the mortgage industry. We’ve built out the foundation of a modern mortgage servicing platform that can accurately handle billions of dollars at scale, but we’re just getting started. At Valon, we want you to do the best work of your life. You'll be surrounded by a tight\-knit community of exceptional people from places like Stripe, Jane Street, Meta, and Google who care deeply about their work and each other. Our problem space is complex, but you’ll get a lot of autonomy so that you can learn quickly, execute effectively, and deliver the highest level of business impact. We have offices in New York City and San Francisco. Plus, we fully support remote work! **About the Role** ------------------ We’re looking for an engineering manager to support Valon’s growing engineering team. In this role, you’ll lead 4\+ engineers across one or more teams, working closely with your reports and partnering with product, design, and operations to build the future of Valon. You’ll empower your team through mentorship, defining long term strategy, strong technical leadership, business acumen, and more to ensure maximum impact and business value. You’ll also work closely with your peers to set the engineering culture and direction at Valon. **Responsibilities** -------------------- * You are responsible for ensuring the successful business outcomes of your team. * Partner with product managers, designers, and operations to develop and successfully execute the R\&D strategy to solve business problems that directly impact homeowners. * Build and develop an incredibly talented team of driven, high performing engineers. * Set a high standard for your team with strong technical leadership, guidance, and mentorship. This is a hands\-on role that will require some coding and architecture design. * Define and evangelize new processes to make your team more effective and deliver an outsized impact. * Push for continuous improvements and innovation using data\-driven decisions. * Partner with other engineering leaders to build a cohesive engineering culture and direction for Valon overall. **Ideal Background** -------------------- * Tech Lead or Engineering Management experience preferred. * At least 4\+ years of software engineering experience. * Demonstrated track record of building and empowering long lasting teams. * Experience working in a highly complex and technical environment. * Experience working in a fast paced and ambiguous startup environment. * Passion for providing the biggest impact with inventive resource planning. * Good written and verbal communication skills. * Demonstrates excellent judgment, problem solving, and decision making. **Benefits** ------------ * Compensation: competitive salary with a meaningful stake in the company via equity, and 401k plan. NB: The base salary range reflects multiple levels. We assess level based on a combination of past experience and interview performance * Health \& well\-being: we’ll invest in your physical and mental well\-being with comprehensive medical, dental, \& vision benefits * Commuter benefits: We offer pre\-tax deductions for public transportation, rideshare services, and parking expenses to make your commute more affordable and convenient * Grow together: Company wide orientation for you to successfully onboard and other learning \& development opportunities including regular review cycles that feature 360 degree feedback * Play together: quarterly budgets for team and company outings. Use it for team swag, cooking classes, or team dinners! * Generous time off: flexible paid time off, sick days, and 11 company holidays * Baby bonding time!: 12 weeks off for both birthing and non\-birthing parents \- fully paid so you can focus your energy on your newest addition *Throughout the interview process, please remember that emails will only be from* *valon.com* *email addresses. We will never ask for any personally identifiable information during the interview process itself. Please reach out to talent@valon.com if you have any requests to verify the authenticity of an outreach.* *Valon is an equal opportunity employer that is committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, sex, religion, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, genetic information, pregnancy, or any other protected characteristic as outlined by federal, state, or local laws. Valon makes hiring decisions based solely on qualifications, merit, and business needs at the time.* Compensation Range: $241\.5K \- $284K

jobs.title: Founding AI Research Lead - Agentic AI Lab
jobs.location: San Francisco Bay Area, CA, US
jobs.description: **Founding AI Research Lead \- Agentic AI Lab** *San Francisco Bay Area \| Full time* Backed by 8VC, we are building a world\-class team to tackle one of industry's most critical problems: trusted AI for enterprise operations. **About the Role** Fabrion is designing the future of enterprise AI infrastructure, grounded in agents, knowledge graphs, and multi\-tenant governance. We are working on research inside the Agentic AI Lab to train and evaluate specialized models for mission\-critical enterprise work. The direction is specific and ambitious. We share the full thesis under NDA during the interview process. What we can say here: the program has committed design partners with production data access, dedicated compute, a benchmark\-first plan with clear go and no\-go gates, and a platform team that has already built the governance and serving layer your models will run behind. This is full\-cycle research: problem formulation, data, training, evaluation, and deployment, with your name on the results. **Core Responsibilities** * Own the research agenda: model and training design, evaluation protocol, and the publication plan * Take models from public benchmark results to live customer shadow deployments, with gates you define and defend * Set the benchmark discipline: strong baselines first, published comparables cited, results that survive scrutiny * Lead and grow a small team (ML engineer, data engineer, contractors) and pair closely with the founders and platform team * Write technical plans internally and papers externally when results warrant it **Desired Experience** * Hands\-on experience training sequence models, owning the tokenizer, the training loop, and the evaluation, not only fine\-tuning through APIs * Strong background in at least two of: reinforcement learning (especially offline and imitation settings), sequence decision modeling, structured or constrained generation, learning from event and log data * A track record of shipping research into a product or landing a rigorous benchmark result * PhD in machine learning or a closely related field, or an equivalent research record * Preferred Tech Stack * PyTorch, the Hugging Face ecosystem, experiment tracking and reproducible training pipelines, modern cloud data warehouses, evaluation harness engineering **Soft Skills \& Mindset** * Comfortable as the most senior researcher in the room: setting direction under ambiguity and writing decisions down * Rigor over hype: you distrust your own results until the baselines agree * A teacher's instinct: part of this role is turning strong engineers into researchers **Why This Role Matters** We believe specialized models built on governed enterprise data can run real, multi\-billion\-dollar workflows. Your work will not be buried in research reports. It will be benchmarked in public, deployed to real customers, and activated by hundreds of thousands of decisions.

jobs.title: AI Agents & Automations Engineer
jobs.description: Our client is an AI consulting and implementation company working exclusively within the Direct Selling industry. They help businesses move from AI curiosity to real AI capability by working closely with leadership teams. Their focus is on implementing practical AI solutions while building the tools, governance, and internal confidence clients need to continue progressing independently. They are looking for an **AI Agents \& Automations Engineer** with strong engineering fundamentals and hands\-on experience building and deploying production\-ready AI agents. The ideal candidate is comfortable working across different AI agent and automation frameworks and understands the importance of reliability, integrations, monitoring, error handling, and maintainability. The role also involves working directly with clients to understand business processes, identify valuable automation opportunities, and turn them into reliable technical solutions. #### **Responsibilities** **AI agents \& production engineering:** * Design, build and deploy AI agents into live client environments with real users and real business data; * Build the infrastructure around agents, including triggers, queues, error handling, retries, fallbacks and monitoring; * Define the access and infrastructure requirements for each solution, including credentials, permissions, data access, rate limits, service accounts and audit trails; * Design appropriate human\-in\-the\-loop processes where full automation is not suitable. **Agentic AI \& automation:** * Build solutions using different agent and automation frameworks such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Select the right framework and architecture based on the business problem rather than defaulting to a single technology; * Integrate AI agents with external APIs, business systems and data sources; * Turn successful one\-off client implementations into reusable patterns and components. **Client discovery \& solution design:** * Work directly with Operations, Sales, Support, Finance and other client teams to understand existing workflows and identify automation opportunities; * Determine which processes are worth automating and where AI agents can deliver measurable business value; * Translate non\-technical business requirements into clear, buildable technical specifications; * Explain technical decisions clearly to both engineering and non\-technical stakeholders. **Documentation \& continuous improvement:** * Document solutions and conduct handover sessions so client and internal teams can independently maintain what has been built; * Help establish reusable engineering standards and processes for AI agent and automation development; * Automate internal workflows and identify opportunities to improve how the company itself uses AI. ‍ #### **Requirements** * Strong software engineering fundamentals with hands\-on experience in Python or TypeScript; * Demonstrated experience building and deploying AI agents / agentic workflows in production, not only prototypes or sandbox projects; * Hands\-on experience with several agent or automation technologies such as n8n, Make, Zapier, OpenAI Agents SDK, LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK \& Skills, MCP servers or custom orchestration; * Confident working with APIs, integrations and webhooks; * Comfortable with production engineering topics including authentication, scopes, secrets management, logging, monitoring, cost control and API limitations; * Enough infrastructure knowledge to independently deploy and maintain the solutions you build; * Able to demonstrate 2–3 AI agents you have built and deployed with measurable business outcomes such as hours saved, reduced error rates, improved cycle times or revenue impact; * Strong client\-facing and discovery skills with the ability to communicate effectively with non\-technical stakeholders and turn business problems into technical solutions; * Advanced English level; * Pragmatic engineering mindset: able to choose a simple, reliable solution over unnecessary technical complexity. ### **Bonus points for** * Experience with AI evals, observability or agent monitoring; * Experience with RAG and vector databases; * Frontend development experience sufficient to build usable interfaces around AI solutions; * Experience with multi\-agent orchestration; * Security, data protection or compliance experience; * Previous experience in an agency or consultancy environment, working across multiple client projects; * Direct Selling industry experience is a plus, but not required. #### **We offer excellent benefits, including but not limited to** * The chance to join a fast\-growing AI consultancy at the point it's defining a category, with real client exposure from day one; * A permanent, fully remote role with a basic salary and the potential to participate in the share option scheme; * A seat at the table on how we evolve our methodology, our tooling and the way we work with clients. We want you shaping the playbook, not just following it.

Apple Ads helps customers discover relevant products and content while enabling developers, publishers, and advertisers to grow their businesses. Familiarity with analytical data stores and query engines such as Druid, Trino, or similar technologies. jobs.description: We are seeking a Software Architect to define and lead the technical vision for Apple's next\-generation Finance Technology Platform. jobs.description: We are the software supply chain security team, part of Apple Services Engineering (ASE) Security org. We work on the software behind iCloud, App Store, Apple Music, TV\+, and Commerce. Our job is to make software Apple can trust: know what goes into it, catch the security problems in it before they ship, and keep unsafe code out of production. Engineering teams across Apple Services build against the tooling we provide. The near\-term work is assurance signal. Scanners, design reviews, and code analysis produce findings faster than anyone can judge them, so engineers hand\-triage noise and stop trusting the output. That triage step sets the ceiling on how much assurance we can run and on how much of it our partner teams act on. We are building automated security assurance that produces findings engineers trust: agentic and LLM\-driven analysis, wrapped in the evaluation harnesses and guardrails that keep non\-deterministic components honest as inputs, targets, and models change. The longer\-term agenda is the supply chain itself. Today nobody can answer questions about a running service without a person spending a day chasing registries, build systems, and scanners: what went into this build, where each dependency came from, who owns fixing it when it goes bad. We are building the paved path that answers those questions by construction, through dependency risk management, build and release integrity, artifact signing and verification, and policy\-based admission of software into runtime. jobs.title: Software Engineer - Build Support Engineering
jobs.description: Imagine empowering hundreds of developers across Apple Service Engineering to build, ship, and hotfix their services faster, more reliably, and with far less toil. At Apple, we don't just build products, we craft experiences that redefine entire ecosystems. The Build Support Engineering (BSE) team sits underneath that work, owning the build, deployment, and hotfix infrastructure that Apple's Commerce and platform engineering teams depend on to get code into production every day. Join us to develop the next\-generation of Apple's cloud services infrastructure. As a Software Engineer on the Build Support Engineering team, you'll play a key role in modernizing large\-scale build and deployment systems \- untangling years of legacy tooling, standardizing on a single containerized build\-and\-deploy path, and building agentic AI systems that triage incidents, debug failures, and support developers autonomously. jobs.title: Sr. Software Engineer, Enterprise Technology Services
jobs.description: Do you want to help build some of the largest and most consequential enterprise and customer technology systems in the world? Join Apple’s Information Systems and Technology (IS\&T) organization. IS\&T is the engine behind everything Apple does for customers and for the people who build for them. It’s Apple’s central nervous system. Supporting 2\.5 billion active Apple devices, processing billions of secure transactions, and keeping the technology that defines modern life running flawlessly, IS\&T makes the impossible feel effortless. Enterprise Technology Services (ETS) is part of IS\&T and delivers global\-scale platforms and services that keep Apple's operations secure and running. jobs.description: **Cloud Network Engineer** **Location:** San Jose, CA **Rate:** $70/hr **Job Summary** We are seeking an experienced **Cloud Network Engineer** to design, implement, maintain, and optimize secure and highly available network infrastructure across cloud and on\-premises environments. The ideal candidate will have strong hands\-on experience with cloud networking, network security, routing and switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancing, and infrastructure automation. The Cloud Network Engineer will work closely with cloud architects, security teams, DevOps engineers, and application teams to ensure reliable, scalable, and secure connectivity across enterprise environments. **Key Responsibilities** * Design, deploy, configure, and maintain cloud network infrastructure across **AWS, Azure, or GCP** environments. * Implement and manage **VPC/VNet**, subnets, route tables, security groups, network ACLs, peering, and transit networking. * Configure and troubleshoot **VPNs, Direct Connect/ExpressRoute, private connectivity, DNS, DHCP, and IP addressing**. * Manage enterprise networking technologies including **TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLANs, NAT, routing, switching, and load balancing**. * Design and maintain secure connectivity between cloud and on\-premises data centers. * Configure and manage cloud and enterprise **firewalls, proxies, WAFs, and network security controls**. * Monitor network performance, availability, capacity, and security using appropriate monitoring and logging tools. * Troubleshoot complex network connectivity, latency, routing, and performance issues. * Collaborate with cybersecurity teams to implement network security policies and controls. * Support high\-availability and disaster\-recovery network architectures. * Automate network provisioning and configuration using **Terraform, Ansible, Python, or similar tools**. * Develop and maintain network architecture diagrams, technical documentation, standards, and operational procedures. * Participate in network migrations, cloud transformation, and infrastructure modernization initiatives. * Perform root\-cause analysis and provide recommendations for improving network reliability and performance. * Participate in incident response, change management, and production support activities. **Required Skills \& Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Networking, or a related field, or equivalent experience. * **5\+ years of experience in network engineering**, with significant experience in cloud environments. * Strong hands\-on experience with at least one major cloud platform: **AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud Platform (GCP)**. * Strong understanding of **cloud networking architecture and security**. * Experience with **VPC/VNet, subnets, routing tables, peering, transit gateways/hubs, NAT, and private endpoints**. * Strong knowledge of **TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, HTTP/HTTPS, VLANs, VPN, BGP, OSPF, and routing protocols**. * Experience with network security technologies including **firewalls, security groups, ACLs, WAF, and IPS/IDS**. * Experience with **Cisco or equivalent enterprise networking technologies**. * Experience troubleshooting complex network and connectivity issues. * Experience with network monitoring and troubleshooting tools. * Strong scripting or automation experience using **Python, Terraform, Ansible, or similar technologies**. * Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, communication, and documentation skills. **Preferred Qualifications** * **AWS Certified Advanced Networking**, **Azure Network Engineer Associate**, **CCNP**, or equivalent certification. * Experience with **AWS Transit Gateway, Azure Virtual WAN, ExpressRoute, Direct Connect**, or equivalent cloud networking services. * Experience with **SD\-WAN** and hybrid\-cloud networking. * Knowledge of **Kubernetes networking and container networking**. * Experience with **Infrastructure as Code (IaC)** and CI/CD environments. * Familiarity with **Zero Trust networking and cloud security best practices**. * Experience working in large\-scale enterprise environments. **Key Technologies** **Cloud:** AWS, Azure, GCP **Networking:** TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, VLAN, VPN, DNS, DHCP, NAT **Security:** Firewalls, WAF, ACLs, IPS/IDS, Security Groups **Automation:** Terraform, Ansible, Python **Enterprise:** Cisco, Load Balancers, SD\-WAN **Monitoring:** CloudWatch, Azure Monitor, network monitoring/logging platforms **Soft Skills** * Strong problem\-solving and troubleshooting abilities * Excellent communication and collaboration skills * Ability to work effectively with cross\-functional technical teams * Strong attention to detail * Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast\-paced environment * Strong documentation and technical writing skills Pay: $70\.00 per hour Expected hours: 40\.0 per week Work Location: In person

jobs.company: Arizona Home Care and Patient Care Infusion
jobs.title: IT Manager
jobs.description: Description: **Behind Every Patient We Serve Is a System That Has to Work.** At Patient Care Infusion and Arizona Home Care, we believe patients deserve exceptional care in the comfort of their own homes. As a locally owned, mission\-driven family of companies — a home infusion pharmacy, a Medicare\-certified home health agency, and a nuclear pharmacy serving hospitals across Arizona — we've spent thirty years building something that works. Now we're looking for an experienced IT Manager to own the technology that holds it all together. This is not just a help desk job. You will be the technology function for all three companies: the servers, the vendors, the equipment, the accounts, and the hard question of whether any of it is actually working the way it should. You'll report directly to the owner. **Pay and Benefits:** * Salary: $115K–$140K/yr * Medical, dental, vision \& life insurance * Health savings account * 401(k) * Up to 120 hours of PTO \+ 6 paid holidays. PTO Increased with tenure. * Annual budget for certifications, training, and continuing education. * A fully stocked kitchen with coffee, snacks, and more **Schedule:** * Full\-Time * Monday–Friday, business hours * Occasional after\-hours or weekend work for scheduled maintenance windows and system cutovers * Phone availability for critical system outages **Key Responsibilities:** * Own and maintain our on\-premise and cloud server infrastructure, network, endpoints, backups, and disaster recovery — pharmacy operations, nursing dispatch, and delivery routing depend on these systems every day * Manage our technology and software vendor relationships end to end: maintain a master contract inventory, track spend and renewal dates, negotiate renewals, run competitive evaluations, and hold vendors to their service commitments * Build and maintain a complete asset inventory covering workstations, laptops, tablets, phones, printers, scanners, network equipment, and vehicle telematics hardware — including assignment, purchase date, replacement cycle, and licensing * Partner with pharmacy, nursing, billing, and dispatch teams to identify where staff are doing manual work our software should be doing, and fix it through configuration, integration, reporting, or automation * Scope, select, and implement new systems — running the pilot, writing the procedure, training the staff, and staying with it until adoption is real * Provision and de\-provision user accounts across all systems, enforce role\-based access, administer multi\-factor authentication, and maintain an auditable record of who has access to what, with same\-day offboarding * Partner with HR to own the technology side of new hire onboarding: role\-based access templates, equipment staging, and day\-one readiness so a new technician or field nurse starts with a working badge, laptop, and every login they need * Help administer and improve our HR platform's onboarding and learning modules, and orient new staff on the systems they'll actually use * Ensure technology practices support compliance with HIPAA, state Board of Pharmacy requirements, and accrediting body standards * Evaluate and manage outside technical resources and contractors when a project calls for additional help * Participate in QAPI initiatives and support a culture of continuous improvement * Perform other duties as assigned Requirements: **Required:** * 5\+ years in a hands\-on IT role with real ownership — small\-business IT lead, senior systems administrator, IT manager, or managed service provider engineer with named\-account responsibility * Demonstrated depth in Windows Server, Active Directory or Microsoft Entra ID, Microsoft 365 administration, networking, and backup and disaster recovery * Experience managing vendor contracts and renewals — not just opening support tickets * Working knowledge of the HIPAA Security Rule and what it requires of technical safeguards, access controls, and audit logging * Strong organizational and time\-management skills with the ability to prioritize effectively in a fast\-paced environment * Strong communication skills, including the ability to explain technology to clinical and administrative staff * Comfort operating as the only technical person in the building * Experience with system integrations, APIs, reporting tools, or scripting **Preferred:** * Experience in healthcare, pharmacy, home health, or another regulated industry * Familiarity with any of: CareTend, KanTime, CPR\+, Paylocity, HubSpot, Sage Intacct, Samsara, Notion * Experience administering an HRIS or onboarding platform, including access templates and automated provisioning * Background supporting a multi\-entity organization with shared services * Relevant certifications * A four\-year degree is not required. We care about what you've run and what you've fixed

jobs.title: 3D Product Configurator & Commerce Integration
jobs.description: **Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration** Drive Commerce / WebGL, integrated with SAP S/4HANA, Centric PLM and PIM/MDM **About Us** Atlas Systems Inc. is a software solutions company headquartered in East Brunswick, NJ. Incorporated in 2003, Atlas delivers solutions across GRC, Technology, Procurement, Healthcare and ERP for customers worldwide, combining more than two decades of software experience with global reach and deep expertise across multiple industry verticals. This role sits within our enterprise retail practice, supporting a premium consumer\-products brand’s direct\-to\-consumer personalization program — where customers configure personalized products (imprinting, embroidery, laser engraving, monogramming, and color / material options) through interactive 3D experiences that must flow cleanly into an SAP S/4HANA\-based commerce and manufacturing backbone. To apply: https://atlas.bamboohr.com/careers/617 **Role Snapshot** **Job Title** Senior Engineer — 3D Product Configurator \& Commerce Integration **Location** United States (remote, with periodic on\-site at the client site as required) **Work Model** Hybrid / Remote **Experience** 8\+ years **Employment Type** Full\-time **Position Summary** We are seeking a Senior Engineer to own the technical implementation, architecture and support of interactive 3D product\-configuration experiences — and, critically, their integration into the enterprise product\-data and order ecosystem. This is not a rendering\-only role. Success depends equally on a high\-fidelity 3D front end and on translating each customer configuration into a correct, orderable SKU, Bill of Materials and price within SAP S/4HANA. You will be the primary engineering owner for the configurator platform (Drive Commerce / WebGL) and its connections to the commerce platform (Salesforce Commerce Cloud), product lifecycle management (Centric PLM), the PIM / MDM layer (Precisely EnterWorks), integration middleware (webMethods), and downstream order management and fulfillment (Manhattan / WMS). In short: you make sure that what the customer configures on screen is exactly what gets priced, ordered, manufactured and shipped. **Key Responsibilities** **3D Configurator Engineering** * **Configurator ownership —** Own end\-to\-end development of interactive 3D web configurators built on the Drive Commerce plugin\-based JavaScript / WebGL framework (Three.js and / or Babylon.js). * **Performance —** Deliver responsive, performant experiences across mobile and desktop against defined performance budgets for load time, frame rate and memory. * **Stability —** Diagnose and resolve rendering, texture and canvas issues, including browser memory leaks and WebGL context loss. * **Technical leadership —** Lead architecture, code review and feature delivery for real\-time product personalization. **Configuration\-to\-Order Integration (core to this role)** * **Recipe** **SAP —** Design and maintain the mapping from a customer’s 3D “recipe” to a valid, orderable outcome in SAP S/4HANA — resolving each configuration to the correct material / SKU, Bill of Materials and price, using SAP variant configuration / configurable materials and made\-to\-order flows as applicable. * **Master\-data sync —** Keep the configurator’s variant / option matrix in sync with master data governed in Centric PLM and Precisely EnterWorks, so options, prices and availability stay accurate. * **End\-to\-end flow —** Build and maintain integrations across the commerce platform, middleware (webMethods / APIs), OMS and fulfillment (Manhattan), delivering accurate build sheets, pick lists and BOMs to manufacturing. * **Availability logic —** Implement made\-to\-order availability and lead\-time logic in the configuration experience (finished\-product availability and lead times, not raw\-material inventory). **Data, Pricing \& Accuracy** * **Data contracts —** Establish stable data contracts (JSON payloads, catalog indexes, option and price models) between the front end and back\-end systems. * **Accuracy —** Ensure price and SKU accuracy end to end, so the configured price and product match what is ordered, invoiced and manufactured. * **Color fidelity —** Implement ICC\-based color management so on\-screen color matches the manufactured product across materials, thread, print and engraving. * **Moderation —** Implement personalization safeguards — profanity and trademark / brand moderation on custom text and uploaded logos. **Asset \& Pipeline Collaboration** * **Asset workflows —** Partner with 3D design / asset teams (internal or agency) to translate high\-fidelity CAD / mesh assets into optimized web assets, communicating payload, texture and performance constraints. Deep 3D artistry and shader authoring are a plus, not the primary function of this role. * **Versioning —** Maintain versioned asset and configuration pipelines with clear release control. **Quality, Performance \& Support** * **Metrics e production support for the configurator and its integrations. **Required Qualifications** * Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline, or equivalent professional experience. * 8\+ years of professional software engineering experience, including significant e\-commerce storefront and / or product\-configurator development. * Hands\-on experience with web\-based 3D graphics — WebGL with Three.js and / or Babylon.js — including performance optimization and browser memory management. * Demonstrated experience integrating a storefront or configurator with enterprise back\-end systems — ERP (ideally SAP), PLM and / or PIM / MDM — covering product master data, pricing and BOM / order flows. This is the key differentiator for the role. * Strong JavaScript / TypeScript and modern front\-end framework experience (React or Next.js; Vue acceptable), REST / GraphQL API design and state management. * Experience delivering complex visual and commerce software within cross\-functional agile teams. **Preferred / Strongly Desired** * Drive Commerce Customizer / 3D Configurator Platform and Drive Recipe API, or a comparable configurator platform. * Salesforce Commerce Cloud (SFRA / OCAPI / cartridges), or an equivalent enterprise commerce platform. * SAP integration experience — variant configuration / configurable materials, material master, pricing and BOM; integration middleware such as web Methods. * Centric PLM and / or Precisely Enter Works, or comparable PLM / PIM / MDM platforms. * Manhattan or comparable WMS / order\-fulfillment integration. * ICC color management and personalization / customization commerce experience (imprint, embroidery, engraving, monogramming). **Technical Skills** * **Front\-end \& 3D:** JavaScript / TypeScript, WebGL, Three.js / Babylon.js, React / Next.js, shaders and materials (working knowledge), responsive UX, browser performance profiling. * **Integration \& data:** REST / GraphQL APIs, JSON / XML transforms, event and middleware patterns (webMethods or similar), product\-data and SKU / variant modeling, pricing models. * **Commerce \& ERP:** SFCC (or equivalent), SAP product and order concepts (variant configuration, material master, BOM, pricing), OMS / WMS order flows. * **Tooling:** Git / GitHub, Jira, CI / CD (Azure DevOps or similar), Webpack / Vite, Postman; AI\-assisted development tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot). **Preferred Certifications** * Salesforce Certified B2C Commerce Developer. * Relevant 3D / WebGL or cloud developer certifications (e.g., AWS or Azure Associate). * Certified Scrum Master (CSM). **Success Measures (first 6–12 months)** * **Performance —** The configurator meets performance targets — Largest Contentful Paint and Core Web Vitals within target on mid\-tier mobile, and a stable target frame rate under full option load. * **Configuration\-to\-order accuracy —** A defined, high percentage of configurations resolve to the correct SAP material / SKU, BOM and price with no manual correction. * **Price accuracy —** The configured price matches the ordered and invoiced price. * **Reliability —** Low configurator error and defect rates in production, and high uptime for the configurator and its integrations. * **Fidelity \& safeguards —** On\-screen color matches manufactured output within agreed tolerance, and personalization moderation prevents disallowed content. * **Scalability —** Reusable components and clear documentation reduce time\-to\-launch for new configurable products. **Core Competencies** * Bridges front\-end 3D engineering and enterprise commerce / ERP integration. * Strong systems thinking across product data, pricing and order flows. * Performance and memory debugging in the browser. * Clear communication with creative, commerce and ERP / data teams. * Ownership of and accountability for accuracy from configuration to manufactured product. * Rapidly learns and integrates new interactive and integration technologies.

jobs.title: Founding Account Executive
jobs.description: **Why Auctor** Auctor is building the AI layer for professional services and software implementation. Think of us as the brain behind the best solution engineers, forward\-deployed engineers, and onboarding teams \- automating the discovery, design, and decision\-making that powers $400B\+ in services work. We’re going after one of the biggest software categories of the decade. **About the Role** Auctor is hiring its Founding Account Executive to build the sales motion from the ground up and establish the company's earliest and most important relationships with Systems Integrators. This is a career\-defning role for a builder who wants to go beyond the standard sales playbook. You will not just be closing deals — you will be defning how Auctor goes to market, shaping the narrative for both business and technical audiences, and establishing the company's footprint with major Systems Integrators. You will work directly with the CRO and partner with Marketing, Product, Engineering, and Deployment teams. This role is on\-site in New York City, 5 days per week. **What You'll Own** * Drive full\-cycle revenue across emerging, mid\-market, and enterprise Systems Integrators, owning the sales process from prospecting to close — average deal size \~$75K, average sales cycle \~120 days * Run end\-to\-end discovery and standard product demos for both technical and business audiences without relying on a sales engineer for every call * Build repeatable sales motions, messaging frameworks, and qualifcation standards that will serve as the foundation for the sales organization as it scales * Operate as an AI\-frst seller, using modern agents and automation tools (including Auctor's own platform) to eliminate low\-leverage administrative, research, and prospecting work * Partner with the CRO, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to translate market feedback into positioning improvements and roadmap input * Establish early logos, lighthouse customers, and long\-term SI relationships that will defne Auctor's market position * Maintain clean HubSpot data and accurate forecasting. **Requirements** **Must\-Have** * 5\+ years of full\-cycle B2B closing experience with a proven track record of exceeding quota in SaaS or professional services sales. * Demonstrated track record of closing deals with average contract values of $50K–$100K\+. * Systems Integrator and ecosystem fuency. Ideally has sold at an SI, sold to an SI, or managed partners at a major ISV. Understands the mechanics and lingo of professional services. * Technically profcient. Comfortable speaking to Solution Architects, Practice Leads, and other technical buyers, and can demonstrate complex software confdently without needing a sales engineer for every call. * Builder mindset. Excited by ambiguity and wants to help build the sales culture, not just inhabit one. * HubSpot profciency. Maintains clean data and accurate forecasting. * NYC\-based and available to work on\-site 5 days per week. * Existing US work authorization. Visa sponsorship available for exceptional candidates. **Nice\-to\-Have** * Direct experience selling software implementation, professional services, or delivery tooling * Background in solution engineering or forward\-deployed engineering roles * Prior to founding AE, early sales hire, or sales lead experience at a startup * Hands\-on experience with AI\-frst sales workfows and modern automation tooling * Network within the SI ecosystem (Accenture, Deloitte, EY\-Parthenon, Slalom, Capgemini, BCG Platinion, KPMG, mid\-market and emerging SIs) **Benefts \& Perks** * Career\-defning role at early\-stage startup * Work directly with CRO, Marketing, Product, and Engineering teams * Shape go\-to\-market narrative and positioning * Establish footprint with major Systems Integrators * Defne sales culture and processes from the ground up * Focus on high\-value strategy and negotiation through AI automation **Interview Process** 1\. Pending Approval 2\. Reached Out 3\. CRO Interview 4\. Replied 5\. CEO Interview 6\. CRO Role Play 7\. Presentation (On Site) 8\. Offer 9\. Hired \#Workwolf

jobs.title: Google Workspace Systems Engineer
jobs.description: **Role Summary** We are seeking a Google Workspace Systems Engineer to play a key hands\-on role in an enterprise migration from Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace and Gemini Enterprise.The resource will work directly with senior architects and external integration teams to configure, test, and execute technical migration workflows across a 150k\+ user environment.**Key Responsibilities** * Execute hands\-on migration of user data, mailboxes, SharePoint, and OneDrive content to Google Workspace and Google Drive. * Configure Google Workspace core services, admin controls, CAA, DLP rules, and SSO integrations with Entra ID. * Build and maintain automation using Google Apps Script, Python, PowerShell, GAM, or AppSheet. * Support coexistence between Microsoft 365 and Google Workspace, including mail routing, calendar sharing, and directory sync. * Assist with Gemini Enterprise rollout, including permissions, data access boundaries, and connector configurations. * Troubleshoot migration, identity, mail flow, DNS, security, and access\-related issues. * Create technical documentation, runbooks, and SOPs for Tier 3 support teams. **Key Qualifications** * 3–6 years of experience in Systems Engineering, Cloud Administration, or IT Infrastructure. * Strong hands\-on Google Workspace administration experience in a medium\-to\-large enterprise environment. * Direct experience with Microsoft 365 to Google Workspace migrations. * Experience with Entra ID / Azure AD, Google Cloud Identity, SSO, SCIM, and provisioning. * Experience with Google Apps Script, Python, PowerShell, or GAM. * Strong troubleshooting experience across mail flow, DNS, SPF, DKIM, DMARC, identity sync, and permissions. Pay: $40\.00 \- $50\.00 per hour Expected hours: 50\.0 per week Experience: * Systems engineering: 5 years (Required) * Google Workspace: 5 years (Required) * Cloud infrastructure: 5 years (Required) * IT infrastructure: 5 years (Required) Work Location: Remote

jobs.title: Field Service Engineer
jobs.description: The **Field Service Engineer** (FSE) provides frontline support by resolving customers' concerns and issues through technical expertise and troubleshooting. The FSE inspects, troubleshoots, repairs, calibrates, and verifies the performance of complex and intricate diagnostic imaging equipment while providing regular communications to Avante Health Solutions team members and customers. This position responds to and resolves all service\-related issues primarily within an assigned territory and requires timely travel response to the customers site location. The FSE position is a remote position that does not require daily or regular attendance at an Avante Company office. *The identification of Essential Job Functions does not display an exhaustive list of all duties that may be assigned to this position, nor does it restrict the related work that may be assigned to this position. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.* ***Essential Job Functions \& Responsibilities*** * Serves as primary onsite support engineer for all customers within assigned territory for contract, warranty, and billable service calls; provides back\-up onsite support in other territories as necessary * Communicates with Service Support team to receive and provide detailed follow\-up information regarding new service calls, follows\-up on open calls, and brings issues to closure * Ensures company values are upheld in all customer communications and the highest level of customer service is provided in all interactions; represents Avante in a professional and positive manor * Uses critical thinking to resolve issues within defined procedures and practices to identify appropriate action to repair equipment rapidly and accurately * Consults by phone, Teams, and e\-mail with Regional Service Manager, Regional Service Lead, and technical staff to communicate information regarding system troubleshooting, diagnosing the problem, and determining best practice to resolve issue; effectively communicates system status and time of escalation per Avante Escalation Procedure * Travels to customer sites to diagnose and repair system failures, provides routine Preventive Maintenance (PM) services, and other duties as required by contract or leadership direction. * Resolves system and component issues by reloading software and replacing hardware to resolve equipment issues and maximize equipment performance to OEM (Original Equipment Manufacturers) specifications * Generates system sales leads and communicates those leads back to sales team * Trains and disseminates knowledge to the rest of the organization regarding equipment * Participates in the on\-call rotation schedule for after\-hours technical support calls * Complies with policies, guidelines, and regulatory requirements per ISO:13485 2016 standards and the Company's Quality Management System * Accepts the FSE role supersedes other designations and includes travel by all modes, and collaboratively follows the chain of command * Demonstrates success and a passion for servicing and learning new technologies which generally incudes training opportunities in Avante supported modalities and system models * Identifies improvement opportunities to processes and offers applications and solutions to promote optimal efficiency * Works professionally, respectfully, and efficiently with all levels within the organization * Adheres to all company employment policies and safe practices * Performs other duties as assigned ***Experience/Training/Education*** * Associate degree in biomedical, electrical/electronics, or computer engineering technology; military training; or equivalent combination of education and experience * 2 to 4 years of medical linear accelerator and/or medical diagnostic imaging troubleshooting and repair experience required; 1\-3 additional years of Linac and/or diagnostic imaging field service repair experience preferred * Above average troubleshooting knowledge of any combination multi\-OEM/multi\-modality (Linac, Cath/Angio, CT, MRI, NucMed, and/or Ultrasound systems) a plus ***Position Requirements*** * A cover letter and resume are required to apply for this position. * In order to service customer contracts, employees could be required to go through different credentialing processes. This is a requirement of this job. * Work remotely from home\-based location * Travel to customer site will include 50\-75 percent of work * Must be ready, willing, and able to travel by all modes of transportation and have a valid driver’s license, and Motor Vehicle Record meeting company requirements and guidelines * Driving record that is insurable ***Knowledge/Skills/Abilities*** **General:** Exceptionally strong analytical and problem\-solving skills. Strong ability to communicate, strategize, implement and retain effective business relationships. Exceptional ability to speak and write effectively in a business environment. Abi ctivity. **Communication:** Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. Ability to write effective, collaborative correspondence. Capacity to read through policies, reporting, and compliance requirements. Ability to speak effectively with customers and employees of the organization. Ability to use multiple forms of communication such as e\-mail, text, MS Teams, virtual conferencing, Phone, etc. and to understand the method for highest priority or informational communications. **Math \& Reasoning:** Ability to define problems, collect data, establish facts, and draw valid conclusions. Ability to interpret an extensive variety of technical instruction in mathematical or diagram form and deal with several abstract and concrete variables. Ability to calculate figures and amounts such as discounts, interest, commissions, proportion, percentages, and volume; ability to apply algebraic concepts. Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and willingness to adapt to change and take initiative. *Physical and Environmental Elements* **Physical Demands:** Ability to bend, crouch, kneel, climb, balance, or otherwise maneuver body while servicing and/or inspecting medical equipment. Capacity to reach with hands and arms for at least 1/2 of the normal work shift. Ability to climb stairs, lift, carry, or otherwise move up to 100 lbs while working with medical equipment. Ability to talk or hear continuously. Ability to see clearly to do all work\-related tasks (clear or corrected vision at 20 inches or less). Finger dexterity is required frequently for over 3/4 of the normal work shift. **Work Environment:** Position is typically performed remotely on customer site with moderate noise levels (examples: hospitals; physician practices, etc.); however, may interact with the production/warehouse environment where temperatures are subject to outdoor conditions in terms of cold and heat. There is exposure to large medical equipment and parts, heavy machinery, and high\-voltage electricity, various tools, and equipment, as well as forklift operations and corresponding noise levels. The position will also be subject to an environment of periods of ionizing radiation, high magnetic field, RF (Radio Frequency) signal emissions, high voltages (floating and ground referenced), Inert gasses (i.e.; Helium, Nitrogen, SF6\-Sulfur Hexafluoride), Cryogenic Liquids (Helium, Nitrogen), possible biohazards on equipment (excrement, blood, etc in a patient environment), possible situations of communicable diseases as working in a hospital and/or patient treatment environment, some carcinogenic materials (slip ring dust, depleted uranium in Linac jaws, etc.). ***Company Culture*** Avante Health Solutions is committed to a respectful and purposeful work environment; this includes each team member taking responsibility for the greater good of the company and its goal to provide exceptional products and service, and to create a sustainable future for the company and its employees. Each team member is expected to strive for excellence in all aspects of their work, as well as actively engage in productive work. Additionally, Avante Health Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer; we proudly promote a diverse workforce and do not discriminate. We encourage all employees and applicants who meet the position requirements to apply for advancement within the organization regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. Harassment or inappropriate behavior of any kind is not tolerated and could be grounds for termination. If assistance or an accommodation due to a disability is needed, please discuss with the hiring manager.

jobs.title: Tech Lead
jobs.description: **Important Notice for Applicants:** At Bixal, we want to ensure a transparent and secure application process for all candidates. Official communication will come from an email address ending in @bixal.com or from @bixal.na.teamtailor\-mail.com. Messages from other sources may be fraudulent, and you should exercise care to avoid any links or attachments included. Bixal will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. **Need Assistance or a Reasonable Accommodation?** If you need assistance or a reasonable accommodation to complete your application, we're here to help. Please reach out to us at talent@bixal.com and let us know how we can support you. You do not need to share personal details or disclose the nature of your request. You can expect a response from a team member within 24 hours during the regular work week and on the next operating day during the weekend or holidays. ### **Why Bixal?** Bixal is a consulting company headquartered in Fairfax, VA, working alongside governments and organizations to help them deliver better services and experiences to the communities they serve. Using evidence\-based knowledge and technology, Bixal empowers clients to deliver on their missions more effectively by fostering a culture of learning and continuous improvement. **Our values:** * **People\-First**: Emphasizing the importance of people in all aspects of work. * **Collaboration and Transparency**: Valuing teamwork and open communication. * **Growth Mindset**: Encouraging innovation and continuous improvement. * **Creating Lasting Impact**: Focusing on meaningful outcomes and positive change. **About the role:** Bixal is seeking an experienced Technical Lead to guide the design, development, and delivery of an enterprise\-scale, accessible digital platform for a federal government client. This role combines hands\-on technical leadership with day\-to\-day client engagement, driving architecture decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, and API implementations that support these and other business functions, while mentoring a cross\-functional delivery team. You will work closely with the Project Manager, product owners, designers, and fellow engineers to mature and modernize the platform, ensuring every release meets rigorous accessibility, security, and performance standards. In close collaboration with the Project Manager, you will lead and engage the client – bringing technical judgement, translating complex technical tradeoffs into clear, confident conversations that build trust and keep delivery on track. Candidates should be prepared to discuss or demonstrate relevant project experience during the interview process. You will have the opportunity to join a project that directly supports Bixal’s mission of improving how government serves people. **Location** This role can work remotely from anywhere in the USA. You must be legally authorized to work in the US. Bixal does not provide visa sponsorship. ##### **Compensation:** This is a full\-time role with a salary range of $135,000 – $155,000\. In the spirit of transparency, most offers tend to land near the midpoint of the range. We make compensation decisions thoughtfully, considering your experience, the skills you bring, and our commitment to internal equity. Fairness and transparency are core to how we operate. **Responsibilities:** ***Technical Leadership*** * Lead architecture and implementation decisions across WordPress, Drupal, and Salesforce, along with API design and integration work connecting these systems. * Guide the team in maturing legacy and evolving platforms into modern, enterprise\-grade, scalable systems. * Set and enforce coding standards, review architecture and code, and drive continuous improvement of technical practices. * Ensure development and design work meets accessibility standards (Section 508, WCAG 2\.1\) across the platform. * Partner with DevSecOps and infrastructure teams to maintain secure, reliable, well\-documented systems. ***Client \& Stakeholder Communication*** * Supporting the Project Manager as the technical point of contact, communicating complex concepts clearly to both technical and non\-technical audiences. * Build and maintain trusted, collaborative relationships with client stakeholders, project sponsors, and cross\-functional partners. * Lead release planning and prioritization by listening to stakeholder input, bringing a clear vision for the solution, and guiding the team toward scope, sequence, and tradeoffs that move the platform forward. * Represent the team in client meetings, technical reviews, and planning sessions with polish and confidence, proactively surfacing risks, tradeoffs, and recommendations to keep the client informed and engaged. * Demonstrated ability to build genuine rapport with clients and stakeholders, remaining calm, positive, and collaborative under pressure. ***Team Leadership \& Mentorship*** * Provide day\-to\-day technical leadership and mentorship to a cross\-functional team of engineers and designers. * Foster a collaborative, high\-performing team culture grounded in accountability and continuous learning. * Guide the team through iterative delivery. ***Delivery \& Quality*** * Develop the technical roadmap collaboratively with the Project Manager, and contribute to its presentation in client and planning sessions. * Drive quality through code reviews, automated testing, and adherence to secure development practices. * Identify and resolve technical risks, bottlenecks, and technical debt before they impact delivery. * Support other technical and delivery activities as needed to keep the platform on track. **Qualifications:** * Bachelor's degree plus at least five (5\) years of relevant professional experience in software development or technical leadership; or an equivalent combination of education and experience. * At least five (5\) years leading or performing on contracts/projects of similar size, scope, and complexity. * Experience migrating or consolidating content management platforms, including hands\-on work with WordPress and Drupal \- theming, custom module/plugin development, and content architecture. * Proven experience designing, building, and integrating RESTful APIs across multiple systems and platforms. * Experience evaluating and integrating third\-party plugins, extensions, and commercial solutions to extend platform capabilities, with sound judgement about when an existing tool meets the need versus when custom development is warranted * Demonstrated experience working within enterprise environments and maturing or modernizing jobs.title: IT Architect - Integrations
jobs.description: ### **It's fun to work in a company where people truly** **BELIEVE** **in what they're doing!** *We're committed to bringing passion and customer focus to the business.* The IT Architect designs, plans, and governs technical solutions that enable secure, reliable, and efficient City operations across enterprise applications, data/analytics, infrastructure, networking, cloud platforms, information security, and end\-user technologies. The role partners with IT teams and business stakeholders to translate requirements into scalable architecture, standards, roadmaps, and reusable patterns; leads or advises delivery teams during implementation; and documents solutions to ensure maintainability, compliance, and long\-term value. Work is performed under general direction with latitude for initiative and independent judgment.**Applicants are required to attach a resume and cover letter.** **Integration Architect Focus:** This position will serve as a hands\-on technical architect for the City’s enterprise integration environment, with Microsoft Azure Logic Apps as a primary integration platform. The role will design and build integrations between major enterprise, financial, HR, utility, public safety, asset management, and customer service systems. The position will work closely with City departments, application teams, subject\-matter experts, and technology vendors to understand business processes and translate them into reliable, maintainable integrations. The City’s integration environment includes Workday and other SaaS, vendor\-hosted, and on\-premises business and operational systems. Integration patterns include APIs, web services, secure file exchanges, data transformations, event\-driven workflows, and other system\-to\-system interfaces. **ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:** *Essential functions, as defined under the Americans with Disabilities Act, may include any of the following representative duties, knowledge, and skills. This is not a comprehensive listing of all functions and duties performed by incumbents of this class; employees may be assigned duties that are not listed below; reasonable accommodations will be made as required. The job description does not constitute an employment agreement and is subject to change at any time by the employer. Essential duties and responsibilities may include, but are not limited to, the following:* * Partner with stakeholders to elicit and refine business and technical requirements; convert them into target architecture, solution designs, and implementation plans. * Define, maintain, and advocate technology standards, reference architectures, and reusable patterns (security, integration, data, networking, cloud, observability, automation). * Produce architecture deliverables (diagrams, logical/physical models, interface contracts, data maps, migration plans, runbooks) and keep them current. * Guide solution delivery across the lifecycle: design reviews, configuration, integration, testing, change control, and readiness for operations; support post\-go\-live stabilization. * Embed security\-by\-design practices (identity, least privilege, encryption, hardening, monitoring) and ensure alignment with applicable compliance frameworks (e.g., CJIS, HIPAA, PCI). * Engineer for reliability, performance, capacity, and cost efficiency; leverage automation/IaC, scripting, and orchestration to reduce toil and improve consistency. * Contribute to disaster recovery and business continuity strategies, including backup, restore, failover, and resilience testing. * Evaluate and select products/services; manage technical aspects of vendor engagements and validate changes by contractors and service providers. * Mentor peers and provide technical leadership within and across teams; share knowledge through documentation, training, and communities of practice. * Create and/or oversee data flows, pipelines, and storage designs as needed to support analytics, reporting, integration, and operational use cases. * Participate in incident response for complex issues; drive root\-cause analysis and continuous improvement of standards and architectures. * Perform other duties as assigned. **MINIMUM** **QUALIFICATIONS:** **Education, Training, and Experience Guidelines** * Graduation with a Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college or university in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field OR four (4\) additional years of directly related experience in lieu of a degree. * Seven (7\)\+ years of progressive IT experience with at least three (3\) years in architecture, design, or senior engineering roles; Senior IT Architect typically ten (10\)\+ years with broad, multi\-domain experience. * A Master’s degree may substitute for up to two (2\) years of experience **Knowledge of:** * Enterprise platforms and practices across one or more domains: networks (LAN/WAN, wireless, firewalls, load balancers), cloud services (e.g., Microsoft Azure), virtualization, operating systems, AP web services, webhooks, messaging, secure file transfers, and other system\-to\-system integration methods**. * Experience with **data mapping, transformation, orchestration, workflow design, authentication, error handling, and integration security**. * Experience integrating **ERP, HRIS, financial, utility, asset management, public safety, customer service, or other enterprise line\-of\-business systems**. Experience with **Workday integrations** is highly desirable. * Experience designing integrations involving **Microsoft Azure services** and cloud\-based application architectures. * Experience supporting **production integrations**, including monitoring, logging, troubleshooting, root\-cause analysis, exception handling, and recovery of failed transactions or data exchanges. * Ability to evaluate business processes and technical requirements and translate them into **scalable, reliable, secure, and maintainable integration designs**. * Demonstrated ability to work directly with **business departments, application owners, subject\-matter experts, technical teams, and external vendors** to define requirements and deliver integrations from design through production support. * Ability to develop and maintain **integration architecture, interface specifications, data\-flow diagrams, technical documentation, and support procedures**. * Experience establishing or applying **integration architecture standards, reusable patterns, API conventions, security practices, and development standards** across an enterprise environment. * Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with the ability to understand **end\-to\-end business processes and data flows across multiple systems**. **PERFORMANCE EXPECTATIONS \& SOFT\-SKILL EVALUATION FACTORS** Technical skills remain primary; the following behaviors will be considered during performance evaluations for Architects and Senior Architects: * Positive Attitude \& Collaboration: Lifts others, recognizes contributions, and leads peers informally when needed. * Initiative \& Independence: Proactively solves problems, stays productive without close direction, and takes ownership for outcomes. * Adaptability \& Learning: Adapts to change, learns continuously, and embraces feedback. * Customer Support Mindset: Provides quality support to internal customers and partners; communicates clearly and respectfully. * Attentiveness \& Listening: Actively listens, seeks clarity, and contributes thoughtfully to discussions. * Leadership Behaviors (for senior roles): Vision, decision\-making, communication, empathy, accountability, innovation, conflict resolution, integrity, and strategic thinking. **LICENSES AND CERTIFICATION REQUIREMENTS** * Valid Class "C" Texas driver’s license required. Out\-of\-state license holders must have a valid license and provide a three\-year driving history. * One or more professional certifications relevant to assignment preferred (examples): Microsoft Azure (e.g., AZ 700/AZ\-305/AZ\-104\), AWS/Azure Solutions Architect, Cisco (e.g., CCNP/CCIE), Security\+ or equivalent; ITIL Foundation; PMP/Project\+; TOGAF. Time\-bounded certification requirements may be specified per posting. **PHYSICAL DEMANDS AND WORKING ENVIRONMENT** Normal office environment with standing, sitting, walking, and standard computer use; occasional lifting, carrying, and on\-site work in datacenters or equipment rooms as needed. May require after\-hours work for changes, incidents, or maintenance. ***Candidates selected to move forward in the review process will be required to complete fingerprint screening to confirm eligibility for Criminal Justice Information System (CJIS) clearance, in addition to the standard pre‑employment process.*** **Hiring Range:** $96,536\.96 \- $120,931\.20, annually. **\#LoveWhereYouWork! Check out the benefits of working with us** **here.** Regular\-Full time*If you like wild growth and working with happy, enthusiastic over\-achievers, you'll enjoy your career with us**!*

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer - Proofpoint and Vulnerability Management
jobs.description: Choosing Capgemini means choosing a company where you will be empowered to shape your career in the way you’d like, where you’ll be supported and inspired by a collaborative community of colleagues around the world, and where you’ll be able to reimagine what’s possible. Join us and help the world’s leading organizations unlock the value of technology and build a more sustainable, more inclusive world. **Location** ------------ This is a remote role based in the US. **About The Job You're Considering** ------------------------------------ We are looking for a Security Engineer with hands\-on experience in Proofpoint Email Security, Vulnerability Management, and Incident Response skills. The candidate will support day\-to\-day security operations, email threat monitoring and remediation, vulnerability tracking, remediation coordination, and incident handling. Exposure to CrowdStrike Endpoint Security will be considered an added advantage. **Your Role** ------------- * Administer and support Proofpoint email security platforms, including PPS, TAP, TRAP, URL Defense, Attachment Defense, and related email protection controls. * Monitor email security health, investigate phishing or malicious email alerts, and support remediation of email\-based threats. * Configure and maintain email security policies such as spam filtering, impersonation protection, DLP, encryption, SPF, DKIM, and DMARC. * Support Vulnerability Management activities including scan review, vulnerability validation, risk prioritization, remediation tracking, and SLA follow\-up. * Work with application, infrastructure, and security teams to coordinate patching and closure of vulnerabilities. * Assist in Incident Response activities by analyzing alerts, gathering evidence, supporting containment, and documenting incident outcomes. * Prepare regular reports, dashboards, and service health summaries for operational and leadership review. * Support integration of security tools with SIEM, SOAR, Azure AD, M365, ITSM, or CMDB platforms where applicable. * Provide secondary support for CrowdStrike Falcon endpoint security alerts, endpoint investigation, and coordination with endpoint or SOC teams. **Your Skills And Experience** ------------------------------ **Required Experience** * 5 to 8 years of experience in cybersecurity operations, email security, vulnerability management, or incident response. * Hands\-on experience with Proofpoint solutions such as PPS, TAP, TRAP, DLP, URL Defense, and Attachment Defense. * Working knowledge of phishing analysis, email threat campaigns, malware indicators, and malicious payload investigation. * Experience with vulnerability scanning tools such as Qualys, Tenable, Rapid7, Wiz, or similar platforms. * Understanding of CVE, CVSS, remediation prioritization, patching workflows, and risk\-based vulnerability management. * Basic understanding of incident response lifecycle, alert triage, evidence collection, escalation, and documentation. * Familiarity with Microsoft 365, Exchange Online, hybrid mail environments, SMTP, DNS, TLS, and mail\-flow routing. * Exposure to CrowdStrike Falcon endpoint security is preferred. **Good to Have** * Knowledge of SIEM/SOAR workflows and SOC operations. * Exposure to CrowdStrike Falcon, Defender, or other EDR tools. * Understanding of CIS benchmarks, OWASP, NIST, and secure configuration standards. * Certifications such as Security\+, CEH, Proofpoint Certified Administrator, or equivalent cybersecurity certifications. **Soft Skills** * Good communication and documentation skills. * Ability to work with multiple technical teams and stakeholders. * Strong analytical mindset and attention to detail. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced global delivery environment. **Primary Skills** * Proofpoint Email Security administration and platform support * Vulnerability Management (Tenable or Qualys preferably) * Incident Response * Email threat analysis and phishing investigation * Vulnerability remediation tracking and reporting **Secondary Skills** * CrowdStrike Falcon Endpoint Security * Endpoint detection and response support * Basic threat hunting and endpoint alert triage **Education** * Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Cybersecurity, Computer Science, or a related field. The base compensation range listed for this position reflects the minimum and maximum target compensation Capgemini, in good faith, believes it may pay for the role at the time of this posting.
