jobs.title: Office Manager/Operations Coordinator
jobs.description: **NOCO Remodeling and Design** **Location:** Loveland, CO **Employment Type:** Part\-Time to Full\-Time **Pay:** $25–$30/hour, based on experience, skills, and demonstrated ability **This position will initially begin part\-time, with the opportunity to transition into a full\-time role based on performance and company needs.** **IMPORTANT — How to Apply** **To be considered, you must apply by emailing Alexa, our hiring manager, directly at alexafredrickson@gmail.com** **\*\*\*APPLICATIONS SUBMITTED THROUGH INDEED WILL NOT BE REVIEWED\*\*\*** Please read the full posting before applying. Application instructions and four short questions are included below. **About the Role** NOCO Remodeling and Design is a growing Northern Colorado remodeling company specializing in bathrooms, kitchens, and home renovations. We're expanding our operations, developing our showroom, improving our systems, and incorporating AI and technology throughout the business. We're looking for an Office Manager / Operations Coordinator who wants to help us build the company—not simply manage a list of administrative tasks. **The most important quality we're looking for is initiative.** If you notice a problem, investigate it and work toward solving it. If something keeps falling through the cracks, create a better system. If you don't know how to do something, research it, use the resources available to you, and figure it out. We're looking for someone whose natural response is: **“I'll take care of it.”** **What You'll Do** This role combines office management, customer communication, project coordination, and operations. Responsibilities will include: * Answering phones and communicating professionally with customers * Managing scheduling, appointments, calendars, and follow\-ups * Coordinating estimates, projects, subcontractors, inspections, and customer appointments * Helping coordinate materials, permits, and project logistics * Keeping project information, documents, schedules, and records organized * Assisting with proposals, estimates, invoices, and project tracking * Following up with customers, vendors, and subcontractors * Identifying problems early and taking ownership of finding solutions * Creating and improving company systems and procedures * Using AI, automation, and technology to make the business more efficient * Anticipating what needs to happen next instead of waiting to be told No two days will look exactly the same, and the role will evolve as the company grows. **Who We're Looking For** We're looking for someone who is **hungry**—ambitious, motivated, hardworking, and genuinely interested in building a career. You may be a great fit if you: * Take initiative without needing constant direction * Take ownership of problems from beginning to end * Follow through until something is actually finished * Look for answers before saying, “I don't know” * Are highly organized and detail\-oriented * Learn quickly and enjoy figuring things out * Think ahead and anticipate needs * Can prioritize when multiple things need attention * Communicate clearly and professionally * Handle direct feedback well * Are comfortable respectfully challenging an idea when you see a better solution * Want increasing responsibility and career growth **Resourcefulness, initiative, judgment, and technological aptitude matter more to us than remodeling experience.** We can teach you our business. It's much harder to teach someone how to think critically, take ownership, and solve problems independently. **AI Proficiency Is a Core Requirement** **You need to be comfortable and proficient using AI.** We're actively incorporating AI and automation into the way NOCO Remodeling and Design operates. We're not looking for someone who has simply used ChatGPT a few times. We want someone who understands how to use AI as a practical work tool and is excited to become even better at it. You should be comfortable using AI to research and solve problems, improve communications, organize information, create procedures and resources, learn unfamiliar tasks, improve workflows, and identify opportunities for automation. You don't need to be a programmer or AI engineer. You **do** need to be technologically confident, capable of learning new tools quickly, and proficient enough with AI to independently use it to accomplish real work. When you encounter something repetitive or inefficient, we want your instinct to be: **“Is there a better way to do this—and can AI or automation help?”** Experience with ChatGPT and other AI platforms, Google Workspace, Microsoft Office, CRM/project\-management software, and workflow automation is strongly valued. **Start Part\-Time. Grow With Us.** This position will initially begin **part\-time** because we're focused on finding the right long\-term person. For someone who demonstrates initiative, good judgment, problem\-solving ability, and a genuine ability to make the company more effective, our goal is to transition the position into a **full\-time role with greater responsibility, opportunity, and earning potential.** And we're not necessarily looking for someone who wants to remain an Office Manager forever. As NOCO Remodeling and Design grows, this position could develop into a larger role in **operations, management, and potentially company leadership.** **If you prove that you're an asset, we want to give you more—not hold you back.** **How to Apply** **Do not apply through Indeed. Applications submitted through Indeed will not be reviewed.** Email your application directly to **alexafredrickson@gmail.com** with the subject line: **Office Manager Application – Your Name** Please include your resume, a brief introduction, and answers to these four questions: **1\. Tell us about a time you noticed a problem at work and solved it without being asked.**What did you do, and what was the result? **2\. Give us a specific example of how you've used AI to solve a problem, improve a process, save time, or produce better work.**What did you use, how did you use it, and what was the result? **3\. Tell us about something you didn't know how to do but figured out on your own.**How did you approach it? **4\. Why does this particular opportunity interest you, and what are you hoping your role could grow into over the next few years?** Following these instructions is the first step in the hiring process. **Experience matters, but how you think, how you work, and what you do when nobody is telling you what to do matters more.** We're looking for someone who wants to **help us build an exceptional company.** Pay: $25\.00 \- $30\.00 per hour Expected hours: 25\.0 – 35\.0 per week Benefits: * 401(k) matching * Paid time off * Professional development assistance * Retirement plan People with a criminal record are encouraged to apply Work Location: In person

jobs.title: Associate Director, Chemical Engineering
jobs.description: **Associate Director, Chemical Engineering** *Nurix Therapeutics is a clinical stage biopharmaceutical company focused on the discovery, development, and commercialization of targeted protein degradation medicines, the next frontier in innovative drug design aimed at improving treatment options for patients with cancer and inflammatory diseases. Powered by a fully AI\-integrated discovery engine capable of tackling any protein class, and coupled with unparalleled ligase expertise, Nurix's dedicated team has built a formidable advantage in translating the science of targeted protein degradation into clinical advancements. Nurix aims to establish degrader\-based treatments at the forefront of patient care, writing medicine's next chapter with a* *new script to outmatch disease.* **Position Description** Nurix is seeking an experienced, independent, and highly motivated individual who will be accountable for end‑to‑end chemical engineering support of bexobrutideg (NX\-5948\) drug substance (DS) from late‑stage development through commercial launch, including oversight of external manufacturing sites. The Associate Director, Chemical Engineering will work closely with the CMC team and colleagues in cross\-functional departments to provide scientific, technical, and hands\-on leadership and oversight of facility and equipment operations at Contract Development Manufacturing Organizations (CDMOs) to support bexobrutideg drug substance manufacturing process optimization and scale\-up. The position will report to the Director, Chemical Development. Responsibilities will include but are not limited to: * Provide engineering leadership to design, develop and optimize scalable routes for small\-molecule DS manufacturing, including demonstrated knowledge in unit operation design, process modeling, process equipment selection and scale\-up methodologies. * Review equipment configurations, qualification packages, and maintenance records at CDMOs to ensure equipment trains are properly qualified, maintained and operating at optimal performance to support Nurix manufacturing operations. * Oversee equipment engineering and scale\-up operations at DS CDMOs, including hands‑on process troubleshooting during engineering, clinical, registration and PPQ batches. * Lead technology transfer to CDMOs including scale\-up and demonstration of new chemical processes in development and commercial equipment. * Coordinate with CDMOs and Nurix Quality Assurance, and Global Supply Chain functions to ensure timely manufacture and release of DS lots. * Partner within Nurix CMC to drive process understanding (critical process parameters, critical quality attributes, control strategy) using engineering principles, DoE and QbD concepts. * Review and approve Master Batch Records, campaign reports, deviation investigations and change controls for drug substance operations. * Ensure manufacturing operations adhere to company quality, safety and regulatory standards (FDA, EMA, ICH, cGMP). * Provide regular Person\-In\-Plant support for DS manufacturing and ongoing performance monitoring of key facility and operational KPIs across manufacturing sites, including schedule adherence, batch performance, deviation trends, and inspection readiness. * Author and review CMC sections of regulatory filings including INDs/IMPD, and NDA/MAA, including responses to Health Authority queries. * Define and drive the long‑term engineering strategy for bexobrutideg DS, including process robustness, lifecycle management, and cost‑of‑goods optimization. * Represent Chemical Engineering on CMC and cross‑functional program teams, providing input to development strategy, risk assessments, and timelines. * Manage and provide technical mentorship of scientists and engineers. **Required Qualifications** * Ph.D. in chemical engineering, or related field with at least 5 years (M.S. with 10 years or B.S. with 15 years) of industrial, late\-phase, small\-molecule drug substance development experience * Extensive knowledge and experience in GMP drug substance manufacturing, characterization, process development, equipment evaluation/selection, scale up and process validation. * Knowledge of solid‑state properties, polymorphism, and crystallization principles relevant to small‑molecule drug substance. * Extensive third\-party drug substance CDMO management experience including tech transfer activities, QbD and DoE studies, clinical supply production, registration batch production and commercial launch activities. * In\-depth knowledge of relevant cGMP, ICH, FDA and EMA guidelines. * Proven track record of effective internal and external collaboration. * Excellent oral and written communication skills, interpersonal skills and problem\-solving abilities. * Ability to multi\-task, manage conflict and work in a fast\-paced environment. * Ability to travel up to 25% of their time. **Fit with Nurix Culture and Values** * Strong team orientation; highly collaborative * Solutions and results\-oriented focus * Hands\-on approach; resourceful and open to diverse points of view **Salary Range:** $189,800 \- $216,700 **Location:** Brisbane, CA \- Onsite

jobs.title: Senior Performance Architect - Heterogeneous Workload Optimization
jobs.description: NVIDIA has been transforming computer graphics, PC gaming, and accelerated computing for more than 25 years. It’s a unique legacy of innovation that’s fueled by great technology—and amazing people. Today, we’re tapping into the unlimited potential of AI to define the next era of computing. An era in which our GPU acts as the brains of computers, robots, and self\-driving cars that can understand the world. Doing what’s never been done before takes vision, innovation, and the world’s best talent. As an NVIDIAN, you’ll be immersed in a diverse, supportive environment where everyone is inspired to do their best work. Come join the team and see how you can make a lasting impact on the world. As EDA workloads transition from traditional CPU\-bound tasks to massively parallel GPU\-accelerated engines, the complexity of identifying bottlenecks has scaled exponentially. We are seeking a Senior Systems Performance Engineer to build our next generation of profiling infrastructure. You will be responsible for measuring, analyzing, and optimizing the interaction between extensive design graphs in system memory and high\-throughput kernels on the GPU. Join us to push the boundaries of what's possible in the future of computing! **What you'll be doing:** * Architecting and maintaining custom profiling frameworks that provide a unified view of execution across CPU (multi\-core/multi\-socket) and GPU (multi\-node/NVLink) environments. * Conducting deep\-dive benchmarking of EDA applications to characterize memory access patterns, cache hit rates, and instruction\-level parallelism. * Using GPU profilers to detect GPU\-side inefficiencies such as warp divergence, sub\-optimal occupancy, and PCIe/NVLink bottlenecks. * Developing tools to monitor and attribute high\-watermark memory usage in multi\-terabyte EDA builds, finding opportunities for data structure compression or smarter memory pooling. * Developing predictive models to guide hardware procurement and cloud instance selection based on built gate\-count and algorithmic complexity. **What we need to see:** * A grasp of the CUDA programming model and experience employing GPU profiling tools like NVIDIA Nsight Systems/Compute to address PCIe bottlenecks and kernel stalls. * Extensive knowledge of profiling tools such as perf, eBPF, VTune, or Valgrind, along with insight into their internal mechanisms. * A passion for meticulous benchmarking and the ability to distill sophisticated performance data into actionable engineering roadmaps. * Experience with distributed compute environments (Slurm, LSF, or Kubernetes). * A BS, MS, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent experience) with more than 8\+yrs of relevent experience and at least 5 years involved in systems\-level performance analysis. NVIDIA offers highly competitive salaries and a comprehensive benefits package. We have some of the most brilliant and talented people in the world working for us and, due to unprecedented growth, our world\-class engineering teams are growing fast. If you're a creative and autonomous engineer with real passion for technology, we want to hear from you! \#LI\-Hybrid Your base salary will be determined based on your location, experience, and the pay of employees in similar positions. The base salary range is 184,000 USD \- 287,500 USD for Level 4, and 224,000 USD \- 356,500 USD for Level 5\. You will also be eligible for equity and benefits. Applications for this job will be accepted at least until September 10, 2026\. This posting is for an existing vacancy. NVIDIA uses AI tools in its recruiting processes. NVIDIA is committed to fostering an inclusive work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.

jobs.description: If you’re passionate about being part of a dynamic organization that enables a Fortune 100 company with nearly $70 billion in annual sales to drive innovation and adopt new technologies that deliver business results, then Nationwide’s Technology team could be the place for you! At Nationwide®, “on your side” goes beyond just words. Our customers are at the center of everything we do and we’re looking for associates who are passionate about delivering extraordinary care.**Work Arrangement:** This role follows a hybrid schedule and requires in\-office presence in Columbus, Ohio two days per week. **Work Authorization:** This role **does not** qualify for employer\-sponsored work authorization. Nationwide does not participate in the STEM OPT Extension program. The Consultant Technology Engineer in this role is the technical counterpart to a DEX product owner/manager. Their job is to make the user technology experience **measurable, reliable, automated, and continuously improving** across devices, applications, identity, collaboration, and workplace services. This role sits at the intersection of **endpoint engineering \+ observability \+ automation \+ data analytics \+ user experience**. **Work you will do:** * Lead transition from operational availability to measuring if the technology is working for the users * Partner across orgs (IT Service Desk and PC Engineering) to align priorities and deliver outcomes that reduce incidents * Provide thought leadership and strategic direction for the Dex platform and capabilities * Clearly and effectively able to describe our Dex platform capabilities and strategy to all levels of leadership and across organizations * **DEX platform engineering \& administration** — Implement, configure, integrate, and maintain DEX platforms * **Experience monitoring** — Measure device health, application performance, login/boot times, crashes, network quality, collaboration performance, and other indicators of employee friction. * **Proactive issue detection** — Identify degradation and recurring problems **before users open support tickets**. * **Automation \& self\-healing** — Build scripts, workflows, and automated remediations for common issues such as application failures, configuration drift, disk capacity, services, certificates, or device performance. * **Telemetry \& data integration** — Bring together endpoint, application, identity, network, ITSM, and user sentiment data to create an end\-to\-end picture of user experience. * **DEX scoring \& analytics** — Develop experience scores, dashboards, KPIs, baselines, and segmentation to identify which user populations are experiencing friction and why. * **Root\-cause analysis** — Correlate telemetry across devices, applications, infrastructure, and services to isolate the technical causes of poor experiences. * **Endpoint experience optimization** — Work closely with endpoint engineering on Windows/macOS configuration, patching, software distribution, device performance, and lifecycle improvements. * **Application experience optimization** — Analyze application responsiveness, crashes, launch times, authentication problems, and dependencies. * **User sentiment** — Combine technical telemetry with surveys and user feedback so that “healthy according to IT” doesn’t automatically mean “good experience for the user.” * **ITSM integration** — Connect DEX capabilities with platforms such as ServiceNow to enrich incidents, automate resolution, reduce ticket volumes, and improve service\-desk diagnostics. * **Change impact measurement** — Measure the user impact of OS upgrades, application releases, configuration changes, migrations, and other technology changes. * **Experience engineering** — Translate recurring user pain points into technical improvements rather than simply resolving individual incidents. * **Security \& governance** — Ensure telemetry collection, automation, and employee data are appropriately secured and privacy\-conscious. * **Continuous improvement** — Establish baselines, identify high\-impact opportunities, implement changes, and demonstrate measurable improvement. **Skills you will use:** **DEX Platforms** Nexthink, ControlUp, Lakeside SysTrack, Teamviewer, WXP, Microsoft Intune analytics/DEX capabilities **Endpoint Engineering** Windows, macOS, Intune, SCCM/MECM, device configuration and troubleshooting **Scripting** PowerShell especially; Python and shell scripting are valuable **APIs \& Integration** REST APIs, webhooks, JSON and integration between enterprise platform **Product Thinking** Employee journeys, personas, outcomes, prioritization and experience metrics **Communication** Translating telemetry into understandable employee and business impact \#LI\-KR1 **Job Description Summary** If you’re enthusiastic about delivering secure technology solutions to support a company providing extraordinary care to its customers, then Nationwide Technology is the place for you. Nationwide's industry\-leading technol ence**: Six years or more of experience with the most complex integrated solutions with an ability to design and develop and modify new and existing solutions for specialized needs. Ability to influence, negotiate, and set priorities are needed. Insurance or financial services industry knowledge a plus. Other criteria, including leadership skills, competencies and experiences may take precedence. jobs.description: Driven by integrity and united by the people\-and\-pet bond, we find strong purpose in the work we do and an even greater joy in those we get to work alongside. Together, we harness the expertise of our long\-standing tradition of excellence to embrace possibility and continuously push to do what's never been done before in pet care. Discover your purpose and fuel your passions when you bring your love of pets to a team that prides itself on the power of togetherness—We are Proudly Connected. Purely Driven. **Position Summary** Since the doors opened in 1972, our Atlanta factory has grown dramatically into a state\-of\-the\-art facility. With safety at the forefront of our minds, our Atlanta factory proudly and passionately produces 460,000 tons a year of our dry pet food brands, including Alpo®, Beneful®, Cat Chow®, Dog Chow®, Friskies®, Purina ONE®, and Pro Plan®. Our factory also does its part for the environment by conserving water, investing in renewable electricity, maintaining zero waste for disposal and more. This plant location is situated along the southern crescent of Metro Atlanta—an area that nearly 6 million residents and many of our associates call home. Atlanta is considered the major commercial and financial center of the Southeast, and together, we contribute to the growth of businesses and population, building the city's strong logistics, entertainment and film, and health services industries. As a Controls Engineer, you’ll provide controls engineering leadership and support to the production, engineering, and maintenance teams. In this role, you’ll work directly with the Plant Controls Group, specifically with PLC programming, project execution, HMI/SCADA, and instrument calibrations to drive continuous improvement on automated processes and equipment. Prepare to design and approve electrical installations per codes and standards, ensuring the reliability and performance of site power distribution systems through technical oversight. **To support plant operations, this position will work an off\-shift schedule. Candidates must be open to working either a 2nd or 3rd shift (not both), with shift assignment based on candidate preference and business needs.** * Provide PLC and HMI/SCADA software and hardware support for the factory * Assist in scope development, requirements, and objectives for electrical and controls projects * Coordinate and implement control system software and hardware upgrades * Develop and maintain the long\-term electrical and controls infrastructure plan for the factory * Maintain current and complete electrical and controls as\-built documentation * Assist in maintenance staff training and development **Requirements** * Bachelor’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 3\+ years’ of experience with electrical troubleshooting, PLC logic system design, technical data interpretation, and hardware application specification in an industrial manufacturing environment. OR * Associate’s Degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field AND 5\+ years’ of experience with electrical troubleshooting, PLC logic system design, technical data interpretation, and hardware application specification in an industrial manufacturing environment. The approximate yearly pay range for this position is $90,000 \- $124,000\. Please note that the pay range provided is a good faith estimate for the position at the time of posting. Final compensation may vary based on factors including but not limited to knowledge, skills and abilities as well as geographic location. Nestlé offers performance\-based incentives and a competitive total rewards package, which includes a 401k with Company match, healthcare coverage and a broad range of other benefits. Incentives and/or benefit packages may vary depending on the position. jobs.title: Facilities Manager| Full-Time | CURE Insurance Arena
jobs.description: Oak View Group: Oak View Group (OVG) is the global leader in premium live entertainment infrastructure and services, with a platform spanning venue development and end\-to\-end capabilities across venue management, hospitality, and sponsorship sales. Founded in 2015, the company serves a collection of seven world\-class owned venues and a client roster of the most iconic arenas, stadiums, convention centers, music festivals, performing arts centers, and cultural institutions, spanning four continents. Position Summary: The **Facility Manager** manages contracted partners and works with the Operations Manager and operations team personnel in the essential duties of ensuring the quality of services delivered to the clients meets and exceeds our standards and contractual obligations. The Facility Manager has direct hands\-on oversight of all building systems, including all services and activities involved in maintenance and operations, including HVAC, electrical, mechanical, plumbing, chillers, refrigeration, ice making, boilers, and associated equipment. Black Seal is preferred. This role pays an annual salary of $70,000 \- $85,000 **Benefits for Full\-Time roles: Health, Dental and Vision Insurance, 401(k) Savings Plan, 401(k) matching, and Paid Time Off (vacation days, sick days, and 11 holidays).** **This position will remain open until December 4, 2026\.** About the Venue: The **CURE Insurance Arena** is a multipurpose arena. It hosts events including shows, sporting events, and concerts. The arena seats 7,605 for hockey and other ice events, 8,600 for basketball and up to 10,500 for concerts, family shows, and other events, which makes it the largest arena in Central New Jersey. Responsibilities: * In accordance with established guidelines and procedures, provide for the timely and efficient training of Operations personnel in coordination with the Human Resources Department. * Develop policies and procedures with Director of Operations to maximize efficient utilization and scheduling of labor coordinated with maintenance and event requirements. * Manage, plan, and organize long\-range assignments for Maintenance. * Troubleshooting and hands\-on repairs in the facility involving, but not limited to, electric, plumbing, HVAC, painting, and wall repair. * Implement and maintain programs with Director of Operations for inspection of facilities and documentation of work orders, including a comprehensive Preventative Maintenance System for all Arena fixed and movable equipment and building systems. * Administer outside maintenance and repair contracts. * Coordinate all inspections with outside regulatory agencies (Fire, Elevator/Escalator, Boiler, Insurance, etc.). * Assist in developing policies and procedures with the Director of Operations to monitor and conserve energy consumption and compliance with Utility Contracts. * Maintain a hazardous materials communication program, material Safety Data Sheets (SDS), and required records and permits; maintain knowledge of changes in pertinent Federal, State, and Local regulations. * Uphold all relevant federal, state, and local building regulations, including EEOC, FLSA, OSHA, NFPA, NEC, and ADA regulations. * Review operation of inventory systems and ensure proper quantities and types of maintenance and show supplies are on hand. Research and recommend equipment, tools, materials, and supplies to fulfill the needs of the Operations Department. * Research and recommend continuing education programs for key technical personnel involved in the operation and maintenance of the building. * Review all budget expenditures, including labor, materials, supplies, equipment, and utility consumption, and recommend policies and procedures to promote efficiency. * Maintain positive working relationships with service contractors, suppliers, utility companies, and firms doing business with the Arena to promote coordinated services to clients. * Provide recommendations for the Capital Improvement Budget, Capital adds, 5\-year plan, and yearly operational budget. * Assist the operations department with the set\-up of events; coordinate facility arrangements with concessionaires and vendors; direct and monitor the work of contractors, engineers, and architects on building projects. * Other duties as assigned. Qualifications: * Degree in an Engineering discipline or related field is preferred but not required. Engineering trade school certification/diploma is a plus. * 3\-5 years of progressive experience in the management of facilities in a comparable industry or convention facility. * Demonstrated skill in managing multiple functions and interpersonal skills to foster teamwork and a commitment to team results are required. * Knowledge of current practices in the maintenance field. * Ability to work various workdays and hours to meet business needs, including early/late hours, long days, weekends, and holidays. Must be reliable and punctual. * Ability to read and interpret documents such as safety rules, blueprints, operating and maintenance instructions, and procedure manuals. * Ability to write daily logs, routine reports, and correspondence. * Ability to communicate effectively to customers, clients, and other employees of the organization. * Ability to apply common sense understanding to carry out instructions furnished in written, oral, or diagram form. * Ability to deal with problems involving concrete variables in standardized situations. * HVAC Certification and/or Electrical License preferred. * Forklift certification is preferred. * Ability to work in a fast\-paced environment to meet deadlines. * Proficiency with Microsoft Office products (Word, Excel, Outlook, and PowerPoint). Strong administrative skills. * Ability to demonstrate technical expertise in the fields of electrical engineering, plumbing, mechanical engineering, heating and air conditioning, welding, painting, and carpentry. * Must be comfortable occasionally working near moving mechanical parts. * Must be comfortable working in environments with moderate noise levels and loud noise levels during events. * Knowledge of Metasys HVAC software preferred. Strengthened by our Differences. United to Make a Difference: At OVG, we understand that to continue positively disrupting the sports and live entertainment industry, we need a diverse team to help us do it. We also believe that inclusivity drives innovation, strengthens our **people**, improves our **service**, and raises our **excellence**. Our success is rooted in creating environments that reflect and celebrate the diverse communities in which we operate and serve, and this is the reason we are committed to amplifying voices from all different backgrounds. Equal Opportunity Employer: Oak View Group is committed to equal employment opportunity. We will not discriminate against employees or applicants for employment on any legally recognized basis (“protected class”) including, but not limited to veteran status, uniform service member status, race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical or mental disability, genetic information or any other protected class under federal, state, or local law.

jobs.title: Entry-Level Project Engineer – Transportation
jobs.description: **We Make Everything Around Us Better** At PRIME AE, that’s not a slogan, it’s how we work. Every bridge, building, campus, park, and roadway we design exists to improve how people live, move, learn, and connect. Through architecture, engineering, planning, and consulting, we partner with clients to create thoughtful, practical solutions that leave communities stronger than we found them. If you want your work to matter, and to be surrounded by smart, collaborative people who care about doing things the right way, you’ll feel at home here. **Who We Are:** **PRIME AE Group, Inc.** (www.primeeng.com) is a nationally ranked, full\-service architecture and engineering firm driven by collaboration, innovation, and a commitment to strengthening the communities we serve. With a growing footprint of offices across the country and a diverse team of more than 550 professionals, we partner with public and private sector clients to deliver thoughtful, high\-impact solutions across transportation, education, healthcare, municipal, federal, commercial, and recreational markets. Our culture blends entrepreneurial energy with the resources of a scaled, multidisciplinary platform—giving our people the opportunity to shape meaningful projects while influencing the future direction of the firm. As PRIME AE continues to expand its capabilities, geographic reach, and leadership bench, this is an exciting time to join a team that is building momentum, investing in growth, and empowering leaders to make a lasting impact. **The Opportunity:** We are currently seeking an **Entry\-Level Project Engineer – Transportation** to join our Indianapolis or New Albany office. This is an excellent opportunity for a recent or upcoming Civil Engineering graduate who is interested in building a career in transportation engineering. You will work alongside experienced engineers and project managers while gaining hands\-on experience supporting our Roadway, Drainage, Traffic, and Bridge teams. The position provides exposure to multiple areas of transportation engineering and may also include utility and railroad coordination, environmental documentation, permitting, and field activities. You will receive guidance and mentorship while developing the technical skills needed to take on greater project responsibility over time. **What You’ll Do:** As an **Entry\-Level Project Engineer – Transportation**, you will assist with the planning and design of transportation and infrastructure projects while developing your technical engineering skills. You will support engineering calculations, design plans, technical documentation, and project coordination across roadway, drainage, traffic, and bridge projects. Working with experienced team members, you will gain exposure to different phases of project development and learn applicable design standards, software, and project\-delivery processes. **Key Responsibilities:** * Assist with the planning and design of roadway, drainage, traffic, bridge, and other transportation infrastructure projects. * Prepare engineering calculations, design plans, exhibits, technical documentation, and cost estimates under the guidance of experienced engineers. * Support roadway design activities, including roadway geometry, grading, intersections, and related improvements. * Assist with drainage, traffic, and bridge\-related engineering assignments based on project needs. * Support utility and railroad coordination, environmental documentation, permitting, and agency coordination as needed. * Learn and apply applicable transportation design standards, engineering practices, and quality\-control procedures. * Collaborate with engineers, designers, project managers, and other disciplines to support project delivery. * Participate in project meetings, site visits, field investigations, and construction\-related activities as needed. * Maintain organized project documentation and assist the team in meeting project schedules and quality expectations. * Continue developing technical knowledge and take on increasing project responsibility as experience grows. **What You’ll Bring:** * Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering from an accredited engineering program, completed or anticipated by the start date. * 0–2 years of experience; recent graduates are encouraged to apply. * Engineer\-in\-Training (EIT) certification or plans to pursue EIT certification preferred. * Previous internship, co\-op, or academic project experience related to civil or transportation engineering is a plus but not required. * Interest in developing experience across roadway, drainage, traffic, bridge, and other transportation disciplines. * Familiarity with MicroStation, OpenRoads Designer, AutoCAD Civil 3D, or similar engineering software through coursework, internships, or professional experience is preferred. * Strong analytical, problem\-solving, organizational, and communication skills. * Ability to work collaboratively, learn from experienced team members, and manage multiple assignments. * Self\-motivated with a willingness to learn new technical skills and grow within the Transportation team. **Why PRIME AE:** We don’t just fill positions; we invest in people. At PRIME AE, you’ll find a supportive, flexible environment where careers are built intentionally, not accidentally. You’ll work on projects that improve everyday life, alongside colleagues who challenge and respect one another. What sets us apart: * **Career Growth**: Flexible career paths across disciplines, from technical expertise to project and people leadership. * **People\-First Culture**: We value trust, integrity, and collaboration, and we mean it. * **Meaningful Work**: Projects that strengthen communities, infrastructure, and public spaces. * **Growth with Purpose**: Strategic expansion backed by strong leadership and investment. * **National Reach, Local Feel**: Big\-firm resources with the agility and relationships of local offices. **Our Commitment:** PRIME AE Group is committed to creating an inclusive environment where differences are respected, voices are heard, and everyone has the opportunity to succeed. \#LI \- Onsite

jobs.title: Process Engineer II
jobs.description: **Salary** ---------- ### **Full Time / Salary** ### **Valley View, OH** ### **Job Number: 1000112** ### **Films Business Unit** **Description** --------------- Reporting to the Product Engineering Leader, the Process Engineer II will lead commissioning and start\-up of a renovated production line and manage the technical transfer of the product line to a contract manufacturer (CM). Peak Nano is a growing organization focused on commercializing nanolayer film to disrupt the capacitor film market. This role will work closely with all functions to ensure high quality, efficient product processing to meet customer specifications. **Key Responsibilities** ------------------------ * Lead commissioning and start\-up of a renovated production line, including operational and performance qualification within an IQ/OQ/PQ framework * Develop and execute commissioning protocols, test plans, and acceptance criteria in collaboration with project engineers, equipment vendors, and internal stakeholders * Travel to the CM site to support equipment set\-up, process trials, and line qualification * Identify and resolve process deviations, yield issues, and equipment reliability problems during start\-up and ramp * Develop and standardize work instructions across product lines, improving consistency and repeatability as the processes mature * Resolve film quality concerns on customer programs; participate in root\-cause analysis investigation and eliminate recurring quality concerns * Drive new product scale\-up from late\-stage development through production trials, resolving process gaps and equipment constraints to hit first\-pass yield, throughput and quality targets **Required Qualifications** --------------------------- * Bachelor’s degree in Engineering along with 5\+ years of experience OR 10\+ years of progressive experience without a degree. * 3\+ years in film or roll\-to\-roll conversion, with direct experience commissioning production lines or transferring processes to contract manufacturers * Ability to work independently on processing equipment * Willingness to travel up to 50% during heavy workload periods to support contract manufacturing scale\-up * Ability to write clear, structured, technical documentation (work instructions, product routings, and product specifications) * Experience working with external processing vendors/toll processing * Ability to learn, apply, and expand technical knowledge around film, plastics and the capacitor industry **Preferred Qualifications** ---------------------------- * Bi\-axial Film Stretching * Experience with NetSuite ERP * Experience interfacing directly with external vendors, Sales, and/or Customers * Lean/Six Sigma Certifications * New product scale\-up and commercialization experience * Experience working in a cross\-functional team environment To be considered for this opportunity, please send your resumé to jobs@peaknano.com with the Subject Line ‘Process Engineer II’ **About The Company** --------------------- ### **Peak Nano** #### **Founded in 2016** Peak is a US\-based, AI\-driven technology company that uses nanotechnology to solve macro\-level global challenges. Our engineers and researchers are developing solutions for advanced optics, aerospace, life sciences, and other industrial solutions. We are the leader in applying artificial intelligence to design and optimize reusable polymers to make the world a safer and more sustainable place.

jobs.title: Lead Electrical Controls Engineering Technician - Oral Care
jobs.description: At Perrigo, we are driven by our mission to ***Makes Lives Better Through Trusted Health and Wellness Solutions, Accessible to All***. We are proud to be a Top 10 player in the European Consumer Self\-Care market and the largest U.S. store brand provider of over the counter and infant formula. Dedicated to providing ***The Best Self\-Care for Everyone***, we are the people behind the brands you trust. We are Opill®, Compeed®, Solpadeine®, NiQuitin®, and many more. **We Are Perrigo**. We are committed to enhancing the wellbeing of our colleagues and consumers alike. We pride ourselves on fostering an inclusive, collaborative culture where each person can experience a sense of belonging. Join us on our One Perrigo journey as we evolve to win in self\-care. **Description Overview** ------------------------ **We are looking for an Engineering Technician with Electrical Controls experience to join our 1st shift team here at our Oral Care Plant located in Grand Rapids, MI!** * The purpose of the Engineering Technician is to troubleshoot, service and repair automation systems, computerized systems, and robotic work cells. These devices and systems include automated controls, robotic assembly devices and computer\-controlled systems across the site. This position provides mentoring and technical direction to technicians responsible for industrial machine repair and equipment within the facilities. This Engineering Technician is also required to develop, design, implement and validate equipment changes / modifications and/or installation of new equipment. Lastly, this technician will be responsible for the development of the Electrical Apprenticeship program by training applicable associates as well as making recommendations to improve On\-the\-Job Training. **Scope of the Role** --------------------- * Perform routine and emergency diagnostic checks, monitoring, and repairs on automated systems. If a problem occurs, the technician will troubleshoot the issue and determine whether the problem is mechanical, electrical, or from the computer systems controlling the process. Once the issue has been diagnosed, the technician shall repair or replace any necessary components, such as a sensor or electrical wiring. * Troubleshoot, service, and repair the computerized systems and robotic devices that are designed to reduce human interaction. * Troubleshoot control systems such as PLC programs, motor VFD's and other electronic components. * Troubleshoot, Modify, and Maintain a variety of Programmable Logic Controllers (PLC) and Human Machine Interfaces (HMI) * Assist on shift and off shift as needed with controls program logic and automation. * Knowledgeable of all different electrical power profiles and be able to troubleshoot effectively. * Create, organize, and maintain documentation related to aforementioned items, including creating and updating prints, schematics, and PLC programs. * Provide instructions and guidance to ensure that Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) and safety standards are adhered to. * Ensure daily housekeeping and safety activity compliance. * Develop, train, and support the electrical apprenticeship program. * Works with engineers on capital projects and related activities including equipment installation, qualifications, and risk assessments. * Assists in developing PM’s and complete safety/quality audits as required. * Continuously looks for and helps to implement improvements to improve productivity, quality, and reduce costs. * Performs normal machine repair as required. * Provide mentoring and technical direction to maintenance and operations team. * Strives to meet or exceed company performance objectives. * Support effective implementation of all GMP requirements and understand how it affect products/processes supported and/or owned. **Experience Required** ----------------------- * High jobs.title: Design Engineer
jobs.description: **We have a lot of ideas. We need someone who can figure out how to actually make them!** We’re looking for a rare combination of **engineer, designer, problem\-solver and maker** to join a small, highly creative team working across two very different Nashville\-based businesses: a multidisciplinary design studio and a specialty food/manufacturing company. This isn’t a traditional engineering job. It isn’t quite a traditional design job, either. We’re looking for someone with an **engineering education, an excellent visual eye and a natural instinct for figuring things out.** Someone who can take: **inspiration → idea → model → rendering → technical drawing → prototype → real life.** Our projects don’t stay neatly inside one discipline or scale. One week you might draw and render a custom banquette. The next, model a component for confectionary production. Then you might lay out a production kitchen, develop fabrication drawings for custom millwork, troubleshoot a manufacturing problem, or help determine how a large\-scale public installation could actually be fabricated and installed. If your brain naturally switches between **“That would be beautiful”** and **“Okay, but how are we actually going to make that?”**, we want to meet you. **WHAT YOU’LL WORK ON** **Interiors \+ Environments** You’ll help translate creative concepts into drawings and visuals that clients, developers, contractors, millworkers, fabricators and our internal team can actually use. Projects may include architectural plans, elevations, sections and details; space planning; field measurements and as\-builts; custom millwork; furniture drawings; finish specifications; equipment layouts; construction\-document coordination; and presentation\-ready renderings. Sometimes you’ll receive an organized brief. Sometimes you’ll receive six inspiration photos, a sketch and a verbal explanation of something that doesn’t exist yet. You should enjoy turning **both** into something clear. **Visualization** We want to see things before we make them. You’ll create: * Photorealistic interior renderings * Product and furniture renderings * Concept visualizations * Material and finish studies * Presentation boards * 3D models * Renderings of your own concepts before fabrication * Polished visuals developed from sketches, inspiration photographs and verbal creative direction You should be able to make something **beautiful enough to communicate the vision and accurate enough to start figuring out how to build it.** **Products \+ Objects** We design beyond rooms. You’ll help develop furniture, displays, packaging, components, fixtures, trays, equipment solutions and other physical objects. That means thinking about appearance **and** manufacturability: tolerances, clearances, hardware, connections, assembly, materials, fabrication methods, cost and what happens when a beautiful rendering meets the real world. **Food \+ Manufacturing** One of the businesses is a growing specialty\-food manufacturer, which gives this role an entirely different technical playground. Projects may include: * Rendering and technically planning a new production kitchen * Developing kitchen and equipment layouts * Helping evaluate new production equipment * Improving workflow and production processes * Helping test, calculate, document and standardize confectionery formulations alongside the production team—including ingredient ratios, **water calculations**, batch scaling and yields * Helping design and document roasting experiments and profiles * Developing packaging, trays, displays and production components * Prototyping solutions to production problems * Helping plan spaces for tours, classes and customer experiences * Building better technical documentation and repeatable systems * Helping prepare a growing manufacturing operation for larger\-scale retail production You’ll work alongside the appropriate food\-science, engineering and other specialized professionals when a project requires expertise beyond your scope. Knowing **when we don’t know enough yet** is an important part of this job. **Fabrication \+ Engineering** We want someone who thinks about how things actually go together. You’ll work with: * 2D drafting * 3D modeling * Millwork drawings * Furniture drawings * Shop drawings * Fabrication drawings * Exploded diagrams * Dimensioned product drawings * Bills of materials * Packaging development * Powder\-coating * Product and component design * Basic mechanical design * Prototyping * CNC\-ready design thinking * Value engineering * Vendor and fabricator coordination * Troubleshooting fabrication problems You should have working knowledge of materials such as **wood, metal, acrylic, plastics, stone and composites**, along with basic structural reasoning, hardware and fastening methods. You don’t need to personally engineer or stamp everything. You **do** need enough technical judgment to recognize when a project needs a licensed structural, civil, MEP or other specia  want to solve them. **Curious.** You genuinely enjoy learning things you don’t already understand. **Resourceful.** “I’ve never done that before” is the beginning of your research, not the end of the conversation. **Deliberate.** You think about what could go wrong before we spend money or build something. **Strategic.** You can see multiple paths to an outcome. **Responsible.** If you say you’re going to figure something out, you follow it through. **Independent.** You don’t require a traditional office or constant supervision to make meaningful progress. And importantly, you’re comfortable disagreeing. We’re not looking for a yes\-person. We’re also not looking for someone whose technical expertise becomes a reason everything interesting is impossible. Our favorite answer is: **“That version won’t work. Here’s why—and here are two versions that could.”** **HOW WE WORK** This is a **Nashville\-based, hybrid and remote\-friendly role.** We don’t work from one traditional office every day. Depending on the project, you may be working remotely from your laptop, at a production facility, at an interior project site, from a coworking environment or alongside members of the team. A substantial portion of the job is independent computer\-based work. You should be extremely comfortable being **laptop\-friendly**: taking a project with you, working independently, documenting your progress and communicating clearly about what you’ve completed, what’s unresolved and what you need from us. You’ll also need to be based in or near Nashville and available for field measurements, site visits, fabrication meetings, installations, production troubleshooting and in\-person collaboration when the project calls for it. If you need the same desk in the same office every day, this probably isn’t the job for you. **CLIFTONSTRENGTHS / STRENGTHSFINDER** We’re interested in **how you naturally think and solve problems**, not just what’s on your résumé. Candidates who move forward in the interview process may be asked to complete the **CliftonStrengths (StrengthsFinder) assessment** and share their results as one additional conversation tool during the hiring process. There is **no required Top 5 and no “correct” result.** However, this position tends to reward behaviors associated with themes such as: **Analytical** Restorative **Learner** Deliberative **Strategic** Responsibility **Focus** Achiever **Discipline** Activator We’re interested in understanding **how you work**, where you’re naturally strongest, and what kind of environment allows you to do your best work. The assessment is one data point—not a pass/fail test. **POSITION DETAILS** **Title:** Design Engineer / Technical Designer **Location:** Nashville, Tennessee **Work Style:** Hybrid \+ remote\-friendly **Schedule:** Approximately 15–20 combined hours/week to start, with opportunity to grow **Employment:** Two part\-time W\-2 positions across two related businesses **Start:** Fall 2026 **Review:** 90\-day review The role is intentionally flexible. Some weeks may lean more heavily toward design work; others toward manufacturing, product development or technical problem\-solving. **TO APPLY** Please send: **1\. Your résumé** **2\. A portfolio or relevant work samples.** This is important. We’re just as interested in seeing what you’ve made as where you’ve worked. **3\. A short introduction answering this question:** **Tell us about something you designed, built, engineered or figured out that you’re particularly proud of. What was the problem, and how did you approach it?** Your portfolio does not need to look like a traditional architecture portfolio. Show us drawings. Renderings. Models. Products. Furniture. Prototypes. Fabrication. Personal projects. Experiments. Things that failed and got better. **We care a lot about how you think.** Pay: $28\.00 \- $36\.00 per hour Expected hours: 15\.0 – 25\.0 per week Benefits: * Flexible schedule Work Location: Hybrid remote in Nashville, TN 37210

jobs.title: Chief Technology Officer
jobs.description: **Founding Chief Technology Officer (CTO)** **10% Equity \| PropTech \+ AI \| Founding Team** **The Opportunity** **We are assembling the founding team behind a new company designed to challenge one of the largest and most established consumer industries in America.** **We aren’t ready to publicly share everything we’re building.** **But we can share the thesis:** **AI is about to dramatically change the economics of selling a home. We intend to be ahead of that change.** **We are building a national real estate platform that combines AI\-powered listing technology, transparent flat\-fee services, and an optional layer of in\-person support into a fundamentally different consumer experience.** **Not another lead\-generation company.** **Not another CRM.** **Not another slightly cheaper version of a traditional brokerage.** **Something different.** **And we’re looking for the Founding CTO who wants to build it with us.** **Why This Is Interesting** **Most startups entering real estate eventually encounter the same problem:** **They can build the technology.** **They can raise money.** **They can generate demand.** **But actually operating a brokerage nationally introduces an enormous regulatory and licensing challenge.** **We have an opportunity to approach the market with licensing capabilities across all 50 states from the beginning.** **That changes what can be built.** **Instead of proving a concept in one state and spending years assembling the infrastructure required to expand, our ambition is national from day one.** **Combine that with experienced leadership, strong sales capabilities, direct industry knowledge and a business model that has already attracted significant interest from venture capital, private industry and strategic players, and we believe the ingredients exist to build something unusually large.** **What We’re Building** **We won’t publish the entire product roadmap here.** **The broader vision is straightforward:** **Flat\-fee real estate \+ AI listing technology \+ optional in\-person services.** **We believe homeowners should be able to use technology to handle significantly more of the home\-selling process themselves while having professional assistance available exactly when they need it.** **That means rethinking the entire experience rather than simply digitizing the traditional one.** **The technology could ultimately touch areas including:** **\* AI\-assisted property listing** **\* Pricing and market intelligence** **\* Listing distribution** **\* Marketing automation** **\* Transaction management** **\* Consumer guidance** **\* Showing coordination** **\* Document workflows** **\* Communications** **\* Brokerage operations** **\* Marketplace/service infrastructure** **\* Local, on\-demand assistance** **Some of what we intend to build is obvious.** **Some of it isn’t.** **The latter is a major reason we’re intentionally keeping this description broad.** **Your Role** **You would join as our Founding Chief Technology Officer and a true equity partner.** **This is not a position where someone else hands you a finished product specification and asks you to manage engineers.** **You will help determine what the product becomes.** **You’ll work directly with the founding team to translate a significant industry opportunity into a technology platform capable of operating nationally.** **Early on, you’ll be a builder.** **You’ll architect.** **You’ll prototype.** **You’ll write code.** **You’ll experiment with AI.** **You’ll decide what we build internally and what we integrate.** **You’ll probably kill some ideas and discover better ones.** **As the company grows, you’ll build the engineering organization around the architecture and technical vision you helped establish.** **The Technical Challenge** **We aren’t looking to sprinkle AI on top of an existing brokerage model and call it innovation.** **The question we’re interested in is much larger:** **If you were designing the process of selling a home today, with modern AI, automation and software available from the beginning, how much of the traditional model would you actually recreate?** **That’s the problem we want our CTO thinking about.** **The platform will require a combination of sophisticated consumer software, AI systems, real estate data, APIs, transaction infrastructure, brokerage operations and automation.** **And there is substantial room for the CTO to influence how those pieces come together.** **Who We’re Looking For** **We’re looking for a technical founder, not simply an employee with a CTO title.** **Someone who can move between architecture and execution.** **Someone who can build the first version and eventually recruit the people capable of building the hundredth.** **Experience with several of the following would be valuable:** **\* Full\-stack application development** **\* AI/LLM systems** **\* Agentic AI and automation** **\* API architecture** **\* Cloud infrastructure** **\* Data\-intensive applications** **\* SaaS platforms** **\* Marketplaces** **\* FinTech or PropTech** **\* Payments** **\* Security and privacy** **\* Real estate/MLS data** **\* Scaling engineering organizations** **Real estate experience is helpful, but not necessary.** **The ability to build quickly, think independently and recognize enormous technical leverage is.** **Why Join Now?** **Because the most interesting time to join a company isn’t after everything is obvious.** **It’s before.** **The founding team brings experience across real estate, brokerage operations, strategy, sales, marketing, product development and company growth.** **We have a significant structural advantage that would be difficult for a new entrant to reproduce quickly.** **We have a defined market thesis.** **We have a clear vision.** **And we are intentionally leaving one major seat at the founding table open:** **Technology.** **The person who fills it won’t inherit the technical strategy.** **They’ll create it.** **Compensation** **This is an equity\-first founding opportunity.** **Founding CTO Equity: 10%** **That’s meaningful ownership because we want meaningful commitment.** **We aren’t looking for someone to spend a few hours each week advising us from the sidelines. jobs.title: Solutions Consultant II- Trust & Safety
jobs.description: **About Stream** ---------------- Stream powers chat, video, activity feeds, and moderation for over a billion end users. From Amsterdam to Boulder to Techstars, we've raised over $58\.25M to build the best Chat, Video, Feeds, and Moderation infrastructure available, with best\-in\-class support. We're 120\+ people across 35 nationalities, and we've been at this for over a decade. Our AI Moderation product is one of the fastest\-growing parts of the platform. Customers use it to detect harmful text, images, video, and audio in real time — configuring policies, harm categories, blocklists, and automated actions, then reviewing what's left in a moderation queue their teams live in every day. When it's tuned well, it protects communities and saves moderators from work no one should have to do. When it's tuned poorly, false positives frustrate good users and real harm slips through. That gap is what this role exists to close. **The role** ------------ You'll own the customer side of Trust \& Safety: getting new customers live, keeping their detection accurate as their communities evolve, and making their Trust \& Safety teams genuinely good at using the product. This is a customer\-facing role with a hands\-on technical edge. You won't be shipping product code, but you will be in the dashboard configuring policies, reading through flagged content to understand why a rule misfired, poking at API responses, and building the reports that show a customer whether their moderation is actually working. You'll be the person a Head of Trust \& Safety calls when their false\-positive rate spikes — and the person who tells our product and engineering teams what needs to change. **What you'll do** ------------------ **Onboarding and implementation** * Run moderation onboarding end\-to\-end: kickoff, policy design, configuration, testing, and go\-live for new customers. * Translate a customer's written community guidelines into working configuration — policies, harm categories, thresholds, blocklists, and automated actions. * Partner with customer engineering teams on integration questions, webhook setup, and moderation events flowing into their systems. * Set a clear go\-live bar with each customer and hold the project to it, keeping stakeholders on both sides aligned on timeline and open items. **Continuous improvement and tuning** * Own ongoing tuning: review flagged and missed content, diagnose false positives and false negatives, and adjust configuration to improve precision and recall. * Investigate escalations when moderation behaves unexpectedly, and drive them to root cause with our engineering team. * Turn patterns across accounts into product feedback, and advocate internally for the changes that would fix them at the source. **Customer enablement** * Train moderators and T\&S leads on the review queue, dashboard, rule builder, and reporting — and make them fast in it. * Build the enablement layer this function needs: onboarding playbooks, configuration templates by vertical, best\-practice guides, tuning checklists, internal runbooks. * Support renewals and expansion by making the value of the product visible: business reviews, usage narratives, and outcomes tied to the customer's own goals. **Cross\-functional work** * Work closely with Sales and Solutions Engineering on late\-stage deals, pilots, and proof\-of\-concepts where implementation reality matters. * Feed the product roadmap with prioritized, evidence\-backed customer needs. * Help scale the function as the customer base grows — including documenting what you do so the next hires ramp faster than you did. **What we're looking for** -------------------------- * 3\+ years in a customer\-facing role at a technical or SaaS company — customer success, implementation, solutions consulting, technical account management, professional services, or Trust \& Safety operations with external stakeholders. * Comfortable being technical without being an engineer * Strong project management instincts. You can run several onboardings at once and keep every one of them honest about where it stands. * Analytical: you're drawn to the question "is this actually working?" and you know how to answer it with data rather than vibes. * Excellent written and verbal communication. You can hold a room of moderators in a training session and a room of executives in a business review, and adjust accordingly. * Willingness to engage with difficult content. This role involves reviewing examples of harmful material — harassment, hate speech, NSFW imagery, and similar — as part of tuning and diagnosis. We take reviewer wellbeing seriously and will talk openly about this in the process. * Based in or willing to relocate to the Boulder, CO area, with 3 days per week in our Boulder office. **Nice to have** ---------------- * Direct Trust \& Safety, content moderation, or community operations experience — in\-house at a platform, at a BPO/vendor, or at a moderation tooling company. * Famil eam gives you unique personal and professional growth opportunities. The opportunity of true ownership and accountability has a massive impact on your career. These are the things you can rarely experience in huge corporations. * **Be on the front line of progress and innovation.** While working with cutting\-edge technology, we are passionate about tackling difficult tech problems at scale and creating reusable components for them, empowering engineering teams to ship apps faster, more securely, and with a better user experience. * **They believe in us:** Stream is backed by leading VC companies (Felicis Ventures, GGV Capital, 01\.Advisors, Techstars, Arthur Ventures), including backers like Dick Costolo (01 Advisors, ex\-CEO of Twitter), Olivier Pomel (CEO of Datadog), Tom Preston\-Werner (Co\-Founder of GitHub), Nicolas Dessaigne (Co\-Founder of Algolia), Johnny Boufarhat (Founder and CEO of Hopin). **What we have to offer you** ----------------------------- Stream employees enjoy some of the best job benefits in the industry: * 19\+ days of paid time off plus 10 paid holidays * Hybrid work flexibility (3 days a week from the office) * Free health insurance for the employee and partial coverage for dependents (80% contribution coverage for health and 100% for dental and vision) * 401k contribution plan with 4% match * Fitness stipend * Company equity * Dog\-friendly office! * A Macbook Pro provided * A Learning and Development budget * Team lunches and plenty of snacks * RTD pass \+ free parking pass on Pearl Street * Bi\-weekly office massages * An office on Pearl Street in downtown Boulder * 12 weeks paid parental leave for primary parents * The opportunity to attend or present to global conferences and meetups * The possibility to visit our office in Amsterdam ***Note:*** *this list of benefits applies to Colorado\-based employees and is adjusted per your location of residence.* **Salary (for Colorado only):** Our salary ranges are based on national averages. We have wide ranges so we can be flexible and determine compensation based on a number of factors including the candidate's skills, level of experience, and location. For Colorado\-based candidates, **the salary range for this position is $100k \-115k**. Compensation at all other locations will be based on the factors as stated above. **Our culture** --------------- Stream has a casual social culture, our team is diverse and we all have different backgrounds. Now, Stream is a team of over 140\+ peers from over 35 countries across the globe. We value transparency, aim for excellence, and support each other on our way to new victories. Our team consists of the strongest talents all over the world, which makes Stream a great place to learn and improve your skills. When it comes to software engineering jobs, our culture is oriented towards ownership and quality: our goal is to deliver stable software. If you are interested in becoming a part of what we do, apply for this vacancy now! ***Hybrid office policy:*** *applicants based (or relocating to) one of our office locations are expected to work according to the applicable local office attendance policy.* ***Equal opportunity employer statement:*** *Stream provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.* *This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.* ***Note for external recruiters:*** *We currently have this role covered and do not accept unsolicited agency resumes. We are not responsible for any fees related to unsolicited resumes.*

jobs.title: Staff Electrical Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Who we are** With its A.I.\-powered robotic technology platform, Symbotic is changing the way consumer goods move through the supply chain. Intelligent software orchestrates advanced robots in a high\-density, end\-to\-end system – reinventing warehouse automation for increased efficiency, speed and flexibility. **What****we need** As a Staff Quality Engineer, you will serve as a senior technical leader and subject matter expert for electrical and electronic quality across Symbotic products. You will provide quality leadership throughout the design, development, industrialization, production, and field lifecycle of complex electrical and electronic systems, including electronic control units, power distribution systems, PCBAs, electrical assemblies, and related subsystems. In this role, you will partner closely with Electrical Engineering, Systems Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, Supply Chain, and Supplier Quality to identify and mitigate quality and reliability risks early in the product development lifecycle. You will provide technical guidance on electrical requirements, design risks, failure modes, manufacturing controls, validation strategies, and supplier quality to ensure robust product performance and production readiness. You will lead quality planning and risk management activities for new product introductions and production transfers while providing technical leadership for complex electrical quality issues affecting existing products. The Staff Quality Engineer will lead and influence APQP activities from early design and prototype development through production ramp and field performance, ensuring customer, regulatory, reliability, and internal engineering requirements are effectively addressed. This role will also analyze field performance data, electrical subsystem failures, robot health metrics, supplier defects, and site quality trends to identify systemic improvement opportunities and drive increased product reliability. **What****we do** The Quality Engineering team ensures Symbotic products successfully transition from development into production and continue to perform reliably throughout their lifecycle. The team partners cross\-functionally with Engineering, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Supplier Quality, and Test to embed quality planning, risk management, defect prevention, and process validation into product development and production. Quality Engineering provides technical leadership from early product design through prototype builds, production ramp, and field deployment. By identifying risks early, challenging designs constructively, applying robust quality and reliability methods, and using manufacturing and field data to drive continuous improvement, the team helps ensure reliable product launches and consistent system performance. **What****you’ll****do** * Serve as the Quality Engineering subject matter expert for electrical and electronic systems, providing technical guidance across design, development, manufacturing, supplier, and field activities. * Lead quality planning and deliverables for new product introductions and production transfers, including APQP, DFMEA/PFMEA alignment, CTQ definition, Control Plans, validation, and production readiness. * Partner with Electrical Engineering, Manufacturing, Test, and Supplier Quality to identify and mitigate design, component, process, and reliability risks early in the product lifecycle. * Lead complex electrical and electronic failure investigations using structured root\-cause methodologies, drive corrective and preventive actions, and verify effectiveness. * Evaluate manufacturing and supplier readiness through process validation, capability studies, measurement system analysis, production controls, and appropriate part approval processes. * Analyze manufacturing, supplier, test, and field performance data to identify emerging quality and reliability risks and drive systemic product and process improvements. * Influence design\-for\-quality, manufacturability, testability, and reliability decisions by providing data\-driven technical recommendations to engineering and program teams. * Establish and improve quality standards, methods, and best practices for electrical and electronic products while driving lessons learned across product platforms. * Provide technical mentorship to Quality Engineers and act as a senior technical resource for cross\-functional teams. * Communicate significant quality risks, technical findings, and recommended actions to engineering, program, and senior leadership. * Ensure compliance with applicable internal quality systems, engineering requirements, industry standards, and regulatory requirements. * Other duties as assigned. **What****you’ll****need** * Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Electronics Engineering, Computer Engineering, Mechatronics Engineering, or a related engineering discipline is required. * Minimum of 8 years of progressive experience in Quality Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Reliability Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related technical field supporting complex products in a manufacturing environment. * Strong technical background in electrical and electronic systems, including experience with products such as PCBAs, ECUs, power distribution systems, power electronics, wiring/interconnects, sensors, or other electronic assemblies. * Demonstrated ability to assess electrical/electronic design and manufacturing risks, identify failure modes, and lead complex technical investigations from root cause through corrective action and verification. * Strong knowledge and practical application of quality engineering tools and methodologies, including APQP, DFMEA/PFMEA, Control Plans, PPAP, DOE, MSA/GR\&R, SPC, 8D, and structured root\-cause analysis. * Experience supporting new product development and production introduction, including design reviews, risk assessment, validation, engineering change management, supplier quality, and manufacturing readiness. * Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills with the ability to interpret manufacturing, test, supplier, and field data and translate findings into actionable technical recommendations. * Demonstrated ability to provide technical leadership, influence cross\-functional teams, and drive decisions and issue resolution without direct reporting authority. * Experience with statistical analysis tools such as Minitab, JMP, SAA, or equivalent, along with advanced Excel skills. * CQE, Six Sigma Black Belt, ISO 9001/AS9100 auditor certification, or relevant electrical/electronics industry experience and certifications are preferred. **Our Environment** * Up to 30% travel may be required. Employees must have a valid driver’s license and the ability to drive and/or fly to client, supplier, manufacturing, and other company locations. * Employees may be required to use a personal credit card for business travel expenses, which are reimbursed based on the program guidelines. Eligible employees may receive a corporate credit card based on role and travel requirements, but a personal credit card may be needed during onboarding until the corporate card is issued. \#LI\-JP1 \#LI\-Hybrid **About Symbotic** Symbotic is an automation technology leader reimagining the supply chain with its end\-to\-end, AI\-powered robotic and software platform. Symbotic reinvents the warehouse as a strategic asset for the world’s largest retail, wholesale, and food \& beverage companies. Applying next\-gen technology, high\-density storage and machine learning to solve today's complex distribution challenges, Symbotic enables companies to move goods with unmatched speed, agility, accuracy and efficiency. As the backbone of commerce the Symbotic platform transforms the flow of goods and the economics of supply chain for its customers. For more information, visit www.symbotic.com. We are a community of innovators, collaborators and pioneers who embrace our differences, because we know unique perspectives make us stronger and smarter. Every perspective matters. We depend on the collective voices of our employees, customers and community to help guide us as we build a better place to work – for you and the world. That’s why we’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship status, marital status, disability, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, or genetic information. The base range for this position in the posted location is $125,000\.00 \- $171,600\.00 however, base pay offered may vary depending on job\-related knowledge, skills, and experience. The compensation package includes medical, dental, vision, disability, 401K, PTO and/or other benefits.
