jobs.title: Quality Engineer
jobs.description: **Quality Engineer****Department:** Quality Assurance **Reports To:** Quality Manager **Location:** Grand Rapids**Company Overview** Transcendia is a leader in custom\-engineered materials for critical product components across a wide range of markets and applications. The company combines deep material science expertise with broad geographic coverage to deliver exceptional customer service and trusted product reliability.**Position Summary** As a Quality Engineer at Transcendia, you will serve as a key change agent supporting manufacturing operations across our two Grand Rapids facilities located at 2500 Oak Industrial Drive and 2555 Oak Industrial Drive. This is a highly visible, hands\-on role that requires a self\-motivated professional who can work independently, make sound decisions, and drive quality improvements in a fast\-paced manufacturing environment. You will actively partner with Operations, Engineering, and Production teams to identify and solve complex quality and process challenges, reduce operational risk, and ensure the reliability of custom\-engineered materials used in critical applications. Success in this role requires strong analytical skills, a proactive approach, and the ability to balance strategic quality initiatives with day\-to\-day manufacturing support.**Key Responsibilities*** Provide routine on\-site support across both Grand Rapids manufacturing facilities, requiring frequent movement between locations to support quality and operational needs. * Conduct hands\-on inspections, testing, sample collection, investigations, and audits within production environments. * Apply data\-driven problem\-solving methodologies to identify root causes, develop effective corrective actions, and prevent recurrence of quality issues. * Independently prioritize workload and manage multiple projects while maintaining a strong sense of ownership and accountability for results. * Work closely with manufacturing and engineering to develop, implement, maintain and improve quality standards and methods to ensure product quality within manufacturing operations. * Collaborate with and mentor cross\-functional team members through the root\-cause analysis process, continuous improvement process, and supporting a culture of quality. * Lead investigations in response to quality nonconformances and manage timely corrective and preventive actions in alignment with quality system requirements. * Analyze quality data and key performance indicators, identify trends, and initiate actions to address emerging product or process risks. * Plan and execute test method validations. * Participate in internal and external audits. **Qualifications****Education \& Experience*** Experience working in a manufacturing environment requiring regular interaction with production personnel and processes. * Experience utilizing statistical analysis and problem\-solving tools such as Minitab, DOE, SPC, Pareto analysis, capability studies, and root cause methodologies. * Experience with electronic document management systems, SharePoint, or similar collaboration platforms. * Bachelor’s degree in engineering, Science, or a related technical field * Minimum 2 years of experience in quality or engineering within a regulated industry **Required Qualifications*** Ability to work independently with minimal supervision. * Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills. * Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (especially Excel). * Ability to support operations across two manufacturing facilities. * Ability to perform hands\-on manufacturing quality activities and lift up to 50 lbs. * Experience conducting root cause investigations and corrective actions. **Preferred Qualifications*** Experience in flexible packaging, blown film, extrusion, or converting operations. * ASQ Certified Quality Engineer (CQE) or other quality certification. * Experience leading internal or supplier audits. * Experience with DOE, SPC, capability studies, and advanced statistical methods. * Experience with statistical software such as Minitab. * Experience with SharePoint administration or electronic quality management systems. * Experience with test method validation and measurement system analysis (MSA). **Skills \& Competencies*** Strong critical thinking and problem\-solving skills with the ability to evaluate data, identify trends, and develop practical solutions to complex manufacturing and quality challenges. * Self\-driven and highly motivated with the ability to work autonomously, manage competing priorities, and drive initiatives to completion with minimal supervision. * Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a dynamic manufacturing environment. * High attention to detail with excellent documentation, follow\-up, and technical writing skills. * Advanced proficiency with Microsoft Office Suite, including Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams. * Proficiency with statistical analysis software such as Minitab and/or JMP, including data analysis, process capability analysis, and statistical problem\-solving techniques. * Experience utilizing SharePoint or similar document management and collaboration systems. * Strong verbal and written communication skills with the ability to effectively communicate across all organizational levels. * Ability to influence cross\-functional teams and facilitate problem\-solving discussions. * Professional interaction with internal teams, customers, suppliers, and auditors. * Ability to maintain confidentiality and handle sensitive information appropriately. **Work Environment*** Combination of office and manufacturing floor environment, with frequent presence in production areas. * Requires routine travel between Transcendia's Grand Rapids facilities located at 2500 Oak Industrial Drive and 2555 Oak Industrial Drive. * Must be able to wear required personal protective equipment (PPE) while working in manufacturing areas. * Must be able to stand, walk, bend, reach, and perform physical activities associated with manufacturing support for extended periods. * Must be able to lift and carry materials, samples, equipment, or products weighing up to 50 pounds. * Must be capable of safely navigating production environments and performing hands\-on quality inspections and testing activities. **Equal Opportunity Statement** Transcendia is an equal opportunity employer and will consider all candidates for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. **Job Description Revision Date:** 9/2/26

As a member of the Transmission Planning team, you will work alongside experienced engineers and recognized subject matter experts performing steady\-state, dynamic stability, and electromagnetic transient (EMT) studies that support both near\-term operational reliability and long\-term grid expansion. jobs.title: AI + .NET Full Stack Developer (SharePoint) — Legacy Modernization & Cloud Migration
jobs.description: **Job Overview** We're looking for a senior, hands\-on .NET Full Stack Developer to lead three concurrent modernization initiatives: enterprise source control migration, a SharePoint\-to\-GCC cloud migration with AI\-powered search, and legacy application refactoring. **This is not a maintenance role — you will be designing the target architecture, not just executing a checklist.** **Location:** This role requires regular onsite/hybrid presence with client teams and secure environments. Candidates must currently reside in, or be immediately willing to relocate at their own expense to, one of the following metro areas: **New York City, Boston, Washington DC, Chicago, Los Angeles, or San Francisco.** Remote\-only applicants will not be deprioritized. **What You'll Actually Own** **1\. Source Control Modernization: TFS → GitHub** You will not simply move repositories. You will design and document the target GitHub architecture from scratch: repo structure and ownership model, branching strategy, environment promotion flow, CODEOWNERS and required\-reviewer policy, secrets management, and CI/CD pipeline design. Deliverable: a written architecture and migration runbook another engineer could execute from. **2\. SharePoint → GCC Cloud Migration** Migrate SharePoint content and permissions into a **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Government / Government Commercial Cloud (GCC / Assured Workloads)**., correctly handling the security model differences, permission inheritance quirks, and compliance boundaries that don't exist in commercial M365\. You will also evaluate and implement an AI\-powered search layer (e.g., Copilot/Graph\-based semantic search, Azure AI Search, or equivalent) to replace native SharePoint search — this is a stated priority, not a stretch goal: * Lead content, data, and workflow migrations from legacy SharePoint environments into **Google Cloud Platform (GCP) Government / Government Commercial Cloud (GCC / Assured Workloads)**. * Navigate strict government security boundaries, IAM, compliance controls (FedRAMP/NIST), and GCP storage architectures. * **Implement AI Search:** Replace default legacy SharePoint search with advanced AI\-driven cognitive search using **Google Vertex AI Search / Enterprise Search** (vector search, semantic query processing, and RAG architectures). **3\. Legacy Application Refactoring** * Unpack, analyze, and refactor complex legacy monoliths written in **older .NET Frameworks (Web Forms, WCF, MVC) and legacy VB code (VB.NET / VB6\)**. * Re\-architect legacy logic into modular, high\-performance **modern .NET (NET 8\+) APIs** with **React** frontends. **Responsibilities** To be direct: this role is scoped for someone who has actually done this work before, not someone who can describe it. Applications lacking verifiable specifics below will not be considered. * **7\+ years** professional full stack development experience, including **3\+ years** with React (or a comparable modern SPA framework) paired with a .NET backend * Demonstrated, describable experience with **at least one** enterprise source\-control migration (TFS/SVN/other → Git\-based platform) where you owned the target repo/branching architecture — not just ran the migration tool * Hands\-on experience with **Microsoft 365 GCC or GCC High**, including its security/compliance differences from commercial M365 (you should be able to speak to specific differences unprompted) * Working experience with at least one AI\-powered enterprise search implementation (Azure AI Search, Copilot/Graph connectors, or similar) * Direct experience reading, maintaining, or migrating **VB.NET or classic ASP.NET/WebForms** code — this is a required skill, not a preference * Strong SQL Server skills (schema design, performance tuning, migration scripting) * **Must be prepared to complete a technical assessment:** a scoped architecture and a live technical discussion where you walk through actual reasoning on a comparable migration/refactor scenario. This is how we verify hands\-on depth — resume claims alone won't move you forward. **Nice to Have** * Experience with Boomi or another iPaaS platform * Prior consulting/professional\-services background across multiple concurrent clients * Familiarity with legal, financial services, or another regulated industry's compliance constraints Pay: $100,000\.00 \- $145,000\.00 per year Application Question(s): * What specific challenge have you faced when migrating legacy TFC version control history to GitHub Git repositories, and how did you resolve it? * Describe one migration or refactor you personally architected — what was the before/after, and what tradeoff did you make that someone without hands\-on experience wouldn't know to make? * What's one concrete difference between SharePoint permissions in commercial M365 vs. GCC that has bitten you or a team you worked with? Education: * Bachelor's (Required) Experience: * .NET: 8 years (Preferred) * SharePoint: 7 years (Preferred) * CI/CD: 6 years (Preferred) Ability to Commute: * Washington, DC 20590 (Preferred) Work Location: Hybrid remote in Washington, DC 20590

jobs.title: Senior Data Analytics Engineer, Hardware Quality
jobs.description: Our mission at Oura is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award\-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles. Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office. We are looking for a Senior Quality Data Engineer – Hardware to join our Hardware Quality Engineering team. In this role, you will bring together manufacturing, test, device telemetry, field, warranty, and failure analysis data to understand how our products are performing and where we can improve. You will work closely with engineering and manufacturing teams to identify quality trends, investigate failures, improve detection, and help prevent known issues from reaching customers. This is a hands\-on role for someone who enjoys working at the intersection of hardware and data. You will work closely with Hardware Engineering, Quality, Manufacturing, Reliability, Firmware, Operations, and Data teams. **What you will do** ==================== * Analyze manufacturing, factory test, device telemetry, field, warranty, and failure analysis data to identify quality trends and emerging issues. * Connect data across manufacturing systems, test logs, device telemetry, and field returns to understand relationships between how a product was built, how it performed during test, and how it performs in the field. * Support failure investigations by identifying patterns and correlations that help connect field failures back to manufacturing processes, components, test results, or product behavior. * Compare failed and known\-good populations to identify manufacturing, test, telemetry, or component signals associated with downstream failures. * Analyze manufacturing and final test parameters to identify marginal passes, abnormal trends, and opportunities to improve screening and escape detection. * Build cohort\-based warranty and field\-quality analysis across product, build, factory, component, configuration, and time in field. * Apply statistical methods to separate meaningful product and process signals from normal variation and help teams make data\-driven quality decisions. * Develop monitoring and early\-warning indicators that help identify emerging quality issues before they become larger field or warranty problems. * Partner with Quality and Engineering teams to validate findings through failure analysis, controlled builds, additional inspection, or process experiments, and measure whether corrective actions are working. * Identify gaps in manufacturing and quality data, including missing data, inconsistent definitions, traceability gaps, or conflicting metrics, and work with the appropriate teams to resolve them. * Build scalable analytics, dashboards, and automated reporting that give engineering teams clear visibility into product and manufacturing quality. * Partner with Data Engineering and Data Science teams when new data pipelines or infrastructure are needed while owning the Hardware Quality use
